teacher.aboutMe:
Marre Moerel
Born in Breda, the Netherlands in 1966. 
Moerel inititally studied fashion design in Rotterdam (NL); received an BA Hons in sculpture from Exeter (UK), and in 1991 she finalized her studies with a Masters Degree in furniture design from the Royal College of Arts in London (UK).  
In 1993 she moved to New York City, where she worked for 10 years as freelance designer and fine artist, whilst teaching furniture design at Parsons School of Design (1995-1999). 

In 2002, to expand her horizons and in search for new inspiration, Moerel moved to Madrid, Spain, where she established her own design studio/gallery. 
From here she works on self-initiated projects and develops her own collection of objects which range from Furniture design, to Accessories, Lighting and Product design.

Moerel’s aim is to create timeless yet contemporary products and environments; blending together current and historical references with a certain sense of humour and delicacy.
Her work focuses on hand-made objects, to express the inherent beauty of primal materials and processes through the creation of functional yet emotionally charged objects.

Besides producing her own line of products she also collaborates with private clients  as well as internationally acclaimed design companies, such as Cappellini and Offect and her work is represented by establisehd galleries such as Rossana Orlandi, Mint and Aybar Galleries.
She continues her teaching practices at various design schools and universities such as the UEM, ETSAM and IED where she directed a Masters course in Lighting and Product Design.

Both Moerel’s Art and Design have been published and exhibited extensively worldwide.
In 2015 she was nominated Most Influencial Designer of the Year by Interiors Magazine.

teacher.aboutMe:
Soy Juan Pablo Molina, nacido en el año 1987. De profesión profesor de artes, Licenciado en Artes Visuales y Licenciado en Educación, pero desde ya 6 años estoy 100% dedicado al arte del tatuaje.

Fundador y dueño de un reconocido estudio de tatuaje en la ciudad costera Viña del Mar, Chile, donde constantemente recibimos artistas del tatuaje, invitados internacionales.  Nomade Tattoo Studio.

Mi trabajo destaca por mezclar ilustración, realismo y manchas acuarela, predominando la saturación del color en cada tatuaje.

Considero la conversación previa con el cliente como parte fundamental dentro del ritual del tatuaje. Así poder rescatar las ideas más firmes del cliente, para luego comenzar a diseñar en búsqueda de mi propia estética y por supuesto hacer que el tatuaje fluya en relación y proporción del cuerpo.


Estudié Artes Visuales sin pensar que luego me convertiría en tatuador, gracias a eso aplico todo lo aprendido en cuanto a estética, color y composición en cada tatuaje.

También tuve la oportunidad de trabajar 5 años en el rubro del diseño y producción gráfica, donde perfeccioné mis habilidades técnicas en el uso de softwares de diseño para luego complementarlo con la ilustración digital. 

Actualmente sigo aprendiendo del arte en general para poder aplicarlo en mis piezas de tatuaje.

teacher.aboutMe:
Hi! I'm a fiber artist, and I paint with wool and a needle. I specialize in creating highly realistic and representational portraits using a needle felting technique for private commissions and exhibitions. Using wool fiber as a painterly medium is special. It's incredibly tactile, and each of the fibers passes through your hand and touches your fingers before becoming part of the art. Each color and each layer are lovingly placed to create beautiful images. 

I absolutely love teaching this technique and sharing it with my students. I've taught thousands of students worldwide through workshops and online courses. I wrote a best-selling book called Painting With Wool: 16 Artful Projects to Needle Felt. Helping students discover a new medium and expand their creative endeavors is what I live for. Painting with wool is SO FUN and very satisfying! I hope you'll give it a try and felt with me!

teacher.aboutMe:
Hello - I'm Gillian! 

Dubbed the “architect of the unseen” by my clients, I love troubleshooting and getting things unstuck by teasing out and solving the organizational and leadership pain points that come with scaling businesses and teams.

I am a transformational leadership expert and published author, having worked with pioneering tech companies like Wetransfer, Spotify, and Typeform before founding my own globally recognized leadership consultancy, OverTime Leader where we help our clients define and shape the right leadership style and company culture that will enable them to scale fast, effectively, and inclusively.

Prior to founding OverTime Leader, I held senior leadership roles for some of Europe's most creative scaleups including WeTransfer and ustwo. After directly experiencing the highs and lows of scaling under pressure, I decided to double down on my passion for progressive leadership, in a more scalable fashion, by creating OverTime Leader.

I started my career in my family’s Executive recruitment business based in Montreal, QC, who is most notable for recruiting three of Canada’s astronauts. After my dad was diagnosed with Parkinson’s in 2009, I stepped up to run the business alongside my mother. It was at that time where I found the lack of practical leadership books for newly appointed managers and created the solution by co-authoring 'First Time Leader: Foundational Tools to Inspire and Enable Your Team' in 2014 (Wiley).

My clients have included founders and funders, CEOs and CTOs, designers, and entrepreneurs. But regardless of role, they have the same qualities in common:
+ High-achievers that strive for efficiency and excellence
+ Low ego and high humility, focused on empowering teams
+ The growth mindset needed to operate in a constant state of flow

Sono fashion designer con  esperienza su marchi di target giovane internazionali, ma dal 2008 ho scritto di nuovo artigianato e creatività indipendente sui portali delle edizioni Condè Nast  e da allora, attualmente attraverso il mio canale Instagram @gaiasegattini, mi occupo di divulgazione su tematiche riguardanti la sostenibilità, il Made in Italy e la buona imprenditoria, cercando ogni giorno di costruire lo spirito critico del mio pubblico.
Sono e sono stata una delle prime a raccontare in Italia  la scena del nuovo artigianato, facendo rete e creando connessioni, collaborando con fiere di settore come Abilmente, dove da qualche anno curo l'area "Cucito Su Di Te".
Sono fondatrice del festival Weekendoit di Ancona, incentrato sulla condivisione delle tecniche manuali e lo sviluppo della microimprenditorialità, sono stata consulente strategica e di merchandising nel settore abbigliamento per l’imprenditoria digitale.
Fungo da PR e talent scout nel settore dei nuovi artigiani e della sostenibilità, creo rete e connessioni e sono diventata popolare in rete per il mio stile ironico e comunicativo. Mi piace parlare di temi importanti ma con leggerezza e senza presunzione o egocentrismo. 
Se volete approfondire la mia visione del rapporto fra nuovo artigianato e comunicazione digitale, vi consiglio di cercare il mio TEDX talk “Carino non è abbastanza” incentrato sul rapporto fra prodotto manifatturiero e social network,  è stato selezionato per la piattaforma TED ufficiale e successivamente tradotto in inglese.
Nel 2018 ho finalmente lanciato il mio brand di maglieria sostenibile "Gaia Segattini Knotwear" che utilizza solo filati di giacenza o rigenerati. Non si realizzano collezioni stagionali ma una serie di monoprodotti in quantità limitata che vengono presentati tutti i mesi e che includono taglie, sesso ed età differenti. Lo stile è quello che mi ha sempre contraddistinto: immagine grafica, colori forti a contrasto, comunicazione divertente. Ci trovate su IG come @gaiasegattini.knotwear .

teacher.aboutMe:
Hessa Al Ajmani is an Emirati visual artist born in Abu Dhabi and based in Ajman. Her practice as an artist is heavily influenced by curiosity of the human psychology and the natural world, and the idea of observing things which are not so noticeable, but are often present human interactions and daily commutes. Her current work with ceramics translates her passion for exploration and observation by imprinting native plants and wildflowers onto functional ceramicware as a form of research to understand more about the native flora that is present in the UAE. A key element and driving force of her current research is her deep appreciation of pottery as an ancient craft and experimentation through trial-and-error. 

In 2019, Al Ajmani founded Clay Corner Studio, the first public arts studio in Ajman dedicated to ceramics and painting, which she currently manages and teaches regular ceramics classes in. The studio caters to professional and amateur artists and offers facilities, private spaces, memberships and classes. Since then, the studio has become an integral community space for Ajman's residents.

Al Ajmani graduated from Zayed University in 2016 with a BFA in Visual Arts and Applied Psychology. She currently works in Sharjah Art Foundation’s Community and Outreach Programme, organizing workshops, excursions, photowalks, and events to engage Sharjah’s community with artist exhibitions, location, and contemporary themes. 

Some of Al Ajmani’s notable exhibitions and other art-related public appearances include House of Failure at SIKKA Art Fair (2019),  Made in Tashkeel at Tashkeel (2018), Emirates Fine Arts Society’s  Annual Exhibition at Sharjah Art Museum (2018-2019), Vantage Point 6 at Sharjah Art Foundation (2018), Future Perfect Future exhibition at Al Serkal Avenue (2017), Markers & Makers exhibition in Manarat Al Saadiyat (2017), /4 (Out of Four) pilot round in Dubai Design District, twice runner-up for ADMAF’s Creativity Award (2015-2016), and first place winner of CDA’s Human Rights Short Film Competition (2014).

About me: I am a Designer.
In my professional career I’ve gone from simple visual design to complex strategic and tactical design for products and services.
I help companies connect their products and services in a coherent and deferential way with all their stakeholders. I design, develop and integrate the brand strategies with which companies reach their audiences and goals.
I’m currently founder and creative director at Agencia YOU in Madrid
I have spent the past 20 years in digital design and brand strategy. 
In 2015 I developed a methodology aimed at brining brands and users closer together. To do this I pulled on all my experience especially in the fields of Branding and User Experience Design.
Also in 2015 I founded Agencia YOU to bring my Brand User Experience methodology to market.
In 2016 I co-founded "Brand The Gap", a Madrid based Branding community, to bring new Branding trends and ideas by organising monthly events.
And in 2017 I set up KoolBrandSkiool, a high performance centre for advanced Branding.
I've worked for international companies such as IconMedialab, Vogue Magazine, The Marketing Store and Sopra Steria as well as prestigious Spanish agencies like Estudio Oscar Mariné and Tau Diseño.
Most of my recent experience is for the financial retail sector having worked on projects for BBVA, Santander, Bankia and Bankinter. I've taken on projects for clients such as Telefónica, McDonald’s, Ikea, Carrefour and Heinz and have developed assignments in Spain, Portugal, UK, Russia and Singapore.
I’ve given conferences on Brand User Experience for Campus Madrid (Tech-hub/Google), UXERS and Interactive Design case studies for the Pompeu i Fabra University in Barcelona.
I enjoy teaching and have done so for the Carlos III University of Madrid Master's Degree in Advertising Communication . I have also taught at the IED Madrid (Istituto Europeo di Design), the Interactive Advertising Bureau (WholeSocial-IAB, Madrid) and the Madrid School of Marketing.

About Agencia YOU:

We close the gap that may exist between your brand and its audience. We do it by developing brand strategies focused on their users.
Agencia YOU helps its clients in 2 ways: firstly by developing strategies for positioning, contents, re-branding and brand tracking and secondly executing the strategy which may include Naming and Visual ID, Apps and Digital Design, Content creation and Channel activation.

Julien Schleiffer is a concept artist, illustrator, and director specializing in visual storytelling. With over 12 years of experience in advertising, he has built a strong foundation in direction and art direction, working across disciplines such as storyboarding, color design, character design, keyframe art, and illustration.

He has created compelling visuals for clients including Mercedes, the BBC, and Stella Artois, blending artistic expertise with a deep understanding of narrative and composition. His continuous exploration of digital painting has shaped his style, characterized by a free and experimental approach to color and shape.

In addition to his creative work, Julien is an active member of Urban Sketchers, with a passion for portrait painting and rapid sketching. As an educator, he is committed to mentoring the next generation of visual storytellers and artists, equipping them with the right tools to bring their creative visions to life.

Nikolas Antoniou was born in Larnaca, Cyprus, in 1988. He graduated in 2012 from the University of Western Macedonia, Greece, Department of Fine and Applied Arts, where he worked closely with the professors (Artists) Harris Kondosphyris and Manolis Polymeri.

His paintings do not stem from a specific idea or theme. He consciously avoids focusing on specific questions or particular answers and instead, creates new pictures, which generate unknown questions. Thus without great thought, paints vague spaces, objects which appear to be misplaced, both through time and dimension, next to items disjoint, with figures lost in an intense painterly environment, but in the end coexist and interact, giving meaning to their existence, tell a story and express a sentiment.

teacher.aboutMe:
Moi c'est Laura ou Arual je suis une Illustratrice freelance basée à Lyon en France. Originaire dʼun tout petit village des Vosges, j'ai passé mon enfance à la campagne entouré par les champs et la forêt ce qui a développé en moi une certaine fascination pour la nature. Mon esprit créatif m'a amené à entreprendre des études artistiques à Nancy puis Toulouse en terminant par un diplôme supérieur d’arts appliqués en design graphique à Chaumont. 

Le dessin a toujours eu une place importante dans mes projets de design mais c'est après mes études en 2017 que j'ai pu m'y consacrer totalement. Mon style d'illustration est naïf, j'aime naviguer entre le rêve et la réalité. Je puise mon inspiration dans tout ce qui me touche et m’anime notamment la faune et la flore mais aussi l’astronomie qui me passionne. J'aime peindre mais je dessine principalement de manière digitale ! 

Représentée depuis 2018 par l’agence artistique Monica Velours, j'ai eu a chance de travailler pour des clients comme Adobe, Flow magazine, Frankie magazine, Petit Bateau, Ravensburger, Les éditions Hachettes ou encore La thé box. J'ai publié mon premier livre en 2020 "Édith" retraçant la vie d'Edith Piaf pour la collection "Des rêves et des chemins" par Les Minis Confettis.

Tout ce que je souhaite à travers ma pratique artistique c’est de donner un peu de sérénité et de joie aux gens qui regardent mon travail. J’essaye de partager ma bonne humeur et mon optimisme légendaire. ☺︎

Desde 2004, Gustavo Rosa de Moura vem produzindo, escrevendo e dirigindo documentários e séries de TV para emissoras como ESPN, Canal Brasil, Arte 1, Curta!, TV Cultura, HBO etc, além de diversos curtas-metragens que foram exibidos em festivais como Clermont-Ferrand, Rotterdam, Oberhausen e Indie Lisboa. Dirigiu também diversos vídeos para museus e exposições tais como a instalação ​Cubo para o pavilhão do Brasil na Expo de Xangai.

Em 2015, produziu o longa ​Califórnia​ (Rotterdam, Tribeca, Prêmio de Melhor Filme segundo o Público Jovem no Festival da Juventude), e a sitcom ​Quero ter um milhão de amigos​ (exibida pela Warner Channel Brasil), que também dirigiu. Em 2016, estreou seu primeiro longa-metragem de ficção como diretor e roteirista: ​Canção da Volta​ (Mostra Internacional de Cinema de São Paulo), com João Miguel, Marina Person e Francisco Miguez no elenco.
Em 2021 lançou o longa-metragem experimental ​Cora​ (contemplado pelo TFI Latin America Fund). Seu último longa-metragem de ficção, ​Ela e Eu​ (realizado em coprodução com a 20th Century Fox), com Andrea Beltrão, Du Moscovis, Mariana Lima, Karine Teles, Lara Tremouroux e Jéssica Ellen no elenco estreou no 54º Festival de Brasília e recebeu três prêmios: melhor atriz, melhor ator e melhor roteiro.
Gustavo é também, ao lado de Marina Person, criador, diretor e apresentador do Nosso Podcast de cinema. Juntos, Gustavo e Marina criaram também o Nosso Curso de Cinema.

teacher.aboutMe:
Hey! I’m Jarod Crews with Cellar Door Trades, and I’m a contemporary glass artist with a focus on landscapes and botanicals. 

My love of glass started early, I vividly remember losing myself in the rich scenes of glass in our church windows. The way the rainbows of refractions played across the pews and floor-- it was magic. I mean, the Rose Window Notre Dame ... how can you deny that awesomeness? My mother was a glass artist, as well, so I suppose it was almost inevitable that I would someday find myself creating glass of my own. Loneliness led me to discovering Ted Harrison’s work, who has probably been my biggest influence throughout my entire growth as an artist. I was a military kid, you see, and my friends were constantly moving away as their fathers or mothers were stationed elsewhere, but my father was an Army drill instructor, so we stayed put. Anyhow, I found myself in the library often, chasing escape, and this is where I saw a poster our middle-school librarian had hung on the wall: Ted Harrison’s The Eagles. To a kid trying to get away, it was pure visual bliss and still my favorite painting of his. From then on, I lost myself in my own landscape doodles, bright colorful crayola-and-paper vacations. Now, I just make them in glass! 

Once I was able, I would hop in the car and just drive, always in search of amazing scenery. I’ve been all over the US, and looked over some majorly stunning vistas -- These are the images and memories that make their way into my glass designs.  

My husband and I moved to Michigan from the east coast when he retired from the Navy, and I gave up a 14-year career as a stylist and educator for a prominent company. From there I had no idea where I’d pick up. I suppose I could've continued on as a stylist and rebuilt my clientele, but I was burnt out and so instead chose to start up a venture of my own, something completely different, answering only to me. I needed quiet and color. It was slow at first, which is just the way I wanted it to be. I sold my glass in a few local shops, nothing major … low-key. But what began as a super small situation, a way to mainly pass time while I sorted things out, has grown into a full-on, 7-days a week business -- and I cannot imagine doing anything else!   

My tutorial with Domestika will be my first venture into teaching, and I'm super excited to share what I've learned over the years! Thank you for joining me on this glass journey!

Be well!

teacher.aboutMe:
Daniel Valero (n. 1988, Saltillo México) es un arquitecto y diseñador textil con estudios en México, Finlandia y Francia. Daniel fundó el proyecto Mestiz en el año 2015 con el objetivo de crear textiles y objetos salvajes con una fuerte identidad regional mediante el uso de técnicas tradicionales y nuevas metodologías de diseño.
Ha sido reconocido con el premio Nacional de Mobiliario Dimueble, con la Beca Nacional de Artes Aplicadas por el FONCA/ENSAD París y por el British Council de Londres en su programa de residencia artística Housewarming. 
Su trabajo ha sido expuesto en las principales escenarios de arte y diseño como Design Miami, Art Basel, London Design Festival y Collectible en Bruselas entre otras foros nacionales e internacionales. Para Daniel — Mestiz es un examen sobre la colaboración simbiótica entre el diseñador y artesano, que intencionalmente difuminan la linea entre ambas disciplinas.

teacher.aboutMe:
Me llamo María Vázquez (aka @drlivinghome), soy gallega y tengo una misión en la vida: que todo el mundo disfrute de la casa que se merece. Estoy segura de que sintiéndote más a gusto en y con tu casa, te sientes mejor contigo misma y hasta un poco más feliz. Mi especialidad es redecorar casas reutilizando lo que ya hay, renovando muebles, añadiendo piezas de segunda mano y una gran dosis de creatividad.

Después de 10 años trabajando como Directora de arte y Directora creativa, decorando eventos para grandes multinacionales y locales para pequeños negocios, fundé Dr. Livinghome en 2015 para ayudar a particulares a decorar su casa con gusto y con pasión, lo que me ha llevado a aparecer en algunos medios como la revista Mi Casa, AD, El Mueble, Houzz, el blog de la decoradora Emily Henderson o la revista online Apartment Therapy.

teacher.aboutMe:
Elisa Talentino was born in Ivrea (Turin, Italy) in 1981.
She is an Italian artist working with illustration, painting, printmaking and animation.
She realized illustrations for The New York Times, The Washington Post, Yale University Press, Bloomsbury Publishing, La Repubblica, Il Corriere, La Stampa, Mondadori, Einaudi, Bur-Rizzoli, Bompiani, Il Saggiatore, Edizioni e/o, Goethe Institut amongst many others. 

She won for two consecutive years (2017/2018) the Gold Medal of 3×3 Mag Professional Show of New York and has been selected in international illustration competitions such as Ilustrarte (2014), Bologna children book fair (2015) and Society of Illustrators Annual Exhibition (2019 and 2020).
 
In 2017 she realized the animated short film Dandelion, from which the homonymous book (Lazy Dog Press, 2018) was published.
She published also Le jardin d’hiver (Print About Me, 2013), Bendata di stelle (Inuit Editions, 2014), Metamorphosis (La Grande Illusion, 2016), il tramonto birmano (Add Editore, 2016).
Her new children’s book with text by Sara Gamberini, published for the Topipittori publishing house, was released in October 2020.
She lives and works in Turin.

No Canal Brasil fez três temporadas de O Papel da Vida, programa em que entrevistou personalidades como Wagner Moura, Alice Braga, Rodrigo Santoro, Camila Pitanga, Alice Braga, Mariana Ximenes, entre muitos outros atores e atrizes do cinema brasileiro.  No Canal Arte 1 apresentou por cinco anos o Magazine Arte 1 com The New York Times. Na Band, apresentou as sessões de cinema do canal e conduziu o reality de coquetelaria Bar Aberto, em 2020. Na Rádio Eldorado apresenta o CineDrops, boletins diários sobre música e cinema, desde 2010.
Como atriz, participou de Bens Confiscados (Carlos Reichenbach, 2004) e O Casamento de Romeu e Julieta (Bruno Barreto, 2005), protagonizou Casal Neura, primeira minissérie de ficção da MTV Brasil. Estreou como protagonista ao lado de João Miguel em Canção da Volta (Gustavo Rosa de Moura, 2016).
Como diretora, dirigiu com Jorge Espírito-Santo o curta-metragem Almoço Executivo em 1996 (Prêmio de Melhor Direção nos Festivais de Cinema de Gramado e RioCine). Dirigiu também o documentário Person (Festival de Locarno, Menção Honrosa no Festival de Cinema Latino-americano de Trieste 2006, exibido nos Festivais É tudo verdade e Tempo-Suécia), o longa-metragem de ficção Califórnia (Festival do Rio, Rotterdam, Tribeca, Malmø) e a série Até o primeiro disco, exibida pelo CineBrasil TV. 
Em 2020 fez a curadoria do Drive-in Paradiso, que exibiu filmes brasileiros num cinema a céu aberto durante a pandemia. 
Dirigiu a série documental  Rompendo o silêncio para a  HBO, que estreou em setembro de 2021. 
Também produziu o longa-metragem Ela e Eu, uma coprodução da Mira Filmes com a FOX Brasil. 
Marina tem um podcast de cinema ao lado do seu companheiro Gustavo Rosa de Moura (@npdecinema) e os dois ministram o Nosso Curso de Cinema, um curso online e ao vivo. Hitchcock, Stanley Kubrick, Pedro Almodóvar e Cineastas Mulheres são os cursos já prontos.

teacher.aboutMe:
Me interesa la pintura como medio de expresión en el que tanto soporte, como técnica, color y textura juegan una función muy importante en cada obra. Busco la frescura  y la personalidad en cada uno de los materiales y técnicas que utilizo. Que la pintura se comporte como pintura, el papel como papel y el agua como agua.
Respetar cada gesto fortuito o dirigido y buscar lo atractivo en cada proceso, ya que todas las acciones tienen su momento ,intención e  importancia en el resultado final de una obra.
Lanzarme sin previo encaje al soporte, aprovechando esa libertad que me permite un espacio en blanco, construyendo a base de manchas una imagen ,de forma que cada pincelada sea única y cada obra irrepetible. 
Mi obra se centra sobre todo en el océano. Las corrientes, los peces, corales y todo lo que se encuentre dentro o fuera de él.
He crecido al lado del mar y todas mis vivencias y mis recuerdos me llevan a él, haciendo de mi obra un universo paralelo en el que me siento cómoda.
El océano, el agua me regalan un espacio desde el que quiero y tengo la necesidad hablar, contar mis experiencias personales y saber rodearme de toda la belleza que me proporciona estar dentro de él.
Es un mundo en el que he encontrado un lenguaje personal y muy unido a la acuarela que es todo agua y color.
Me gusta trabajar el pequeño y gran formato, dejar que la acuarela sea libre y salvaje como lo es el agua y disfrutar de lo imprevisible.
He realizado varias exposiciones individuales : 
Con " Construcciones en estado líquido" comencé a sumergir retratos de gran formato bajo el agua. Era como una forma de hacer entrar en mi mundo a los demás. Una necesidad de ver lo que yo veía hasta que con " Cha Cha Chá" ( otra exposición)  decidí crear eso que yo veía y crear esos espacios en los que el que entrara en la sala sintiera estar bajo un banco grande de peces.
Mi estudio se ha convertido en una parte de mi océano, donde trabajo cada día compaginando el desarrollo de mi obra personal con algunos encargos de particulares y empresas.
Actualmente estoy trabajando en un proyecto editorial que recoge toda una experiencia personal en paralelo con el océano y en una exposición individual que recoja este mundo interior para sacarlo y haceros partícipe de él.

My design practice at Saul Kim Studio focuses on experimenting with avant-garde architectural design solutions.  
I have a master's degree in architecture from Harvard Graduate School of Design and a bachelor's degree in architecture from Southern California Institute of Architecture.

My personal design series titled 'Architecture Anomaly' explores autonomy, conformity and juxtaposition between architectural parts that challenge the convention of design thinking. I draw inspiration from daily objects and circumstances around me, reinterpreting and applying architectural quality to them. Office S&M elevate the everyday. Established by Catrina Stewart and Hugh McEwen in 2013, Office S&M is an award-winning architecture practice working with a 50:50 split of public clients and private clients on individual homes, new-build housing, workspace retrofit and public realm projects.

The practice engages clients and users in a collaborative process, experimenting with colours and materials to deliver joyful and unexpected private spaces and public places. Office S&M responds to the context of each project – house, street or neighbourhood – acknowledging the existing, while deploying colour and narrative inventively to create drama.

Built projects include: Valetta House (2017), which won the NLA Don't Move, Improve! 2018 'Best use of materials' award; Salmen House (2017); and Mo-tel House (2020) all in London. Current projects include: The Earth House, a newbuild house in East Sussex; the Green Room in Newham; Nag’s Head Market, Holloway; and Chipstead Way, Croydon.

Achievements to date include: winning Building Design’s Young Architect of the Year Award (2020); inclusion in The Architects’ Journal’s 40 under 40 - a showcase of architecture’s brightest up-and-coming talent (2020); and recognition as a Rising Star by RIBA Journal (2019).

teacher.aboutMe:
C’est pendant mon congé parental que j’ai commencé l’aquarelle, ressentant le besoin d’apporter de la créativité dans ma vie de jeune maman. N’ayant aucune notion artistique, je suis partie en exploration de ce médium, sur internet et les réseaux sociaux afin de mieux le comprendre.
Ce qui m’a tout de suite attiré dans l’aquarelle, c’est sa transparence et la manière dont les pigments se déplacent au contact de l’eau. J’aime son côté imprévisible et naturel. 

J’ai commencé l’aquarelle en peignant des portraits, mais ce que je préfère peindre c’est la nature, car grandit dans une maisonnette à l’orée de la forêt et je suis naturellement inspirée par cet univers. Quand je peins à l’aquarelle, je ressens beaucoup de sérénité et de bien être, car avec seulement quelques gestes, il est possible de créer de jolies compositions harmonieuses. 

Aujourd’hui, j’ai réussi à faire de cette passion un métier à mon plus grand bonheur. 
Je travaille avec des enseignes afin de créer des designs et des illustrations pour habiller leurs produits. Je suis ambassadrice de l’enseigne Dalbe, spécialisée dans le matériel de loisirs créatifs et de beaux arts. J’ai écris un livre paru aux Éditions Eyrolles qui s’intitule « J’ose L’aquarelle ». 

Encore aujourd’hui, je continue d’explorer autant que possible toutes les possibilités artistiques que m’offre l’aquarelle. De l’abstrait au réalisme je ne m’ennuie jamais, et ce pour mon plus grand plaisir.

teacher.aboutMe:
Mi chiamo Chiara e sono una calligrafa moderna e digitale. 

Ho sempre amato la calligrafia, fin dalle scuole elementari, ma lo studio vero e proprio è iniziato nel 2009 grazie all'incontro con Monica Dengo, con la quale ho imparato le basi dell'italico e della calligrafia moderna, utilizzando come supporto di scrittura i pennarelli a punta tonda e a punta pennello.

Dal 2012 condivido su Instagram i miei esercizi e lavori di calligrafia moderna e di lettering, soprattutto legati al mondo delle quote ispirazionali e della mindfulness, filosofia di vita che è stata determinante nel trovare il coraggio per cambiare lavoro seguendo le mie passioni.

Dopo aver lavorato per anni nella moda e nell'arredamento, nel 2014 ho aperto il mio e-shop nel quale vendo prodotti realizzati con le mie grafiche, quali timbri, decorazioni in legno, in plexiglas e in vinile, adesivi e biglietti d'auguri, e stationery, altra mia grande passione, scovata in giro per il mondo.

Inizialmente le grafiche erano realizzate su carta ma dal 2017 disegno tutto su Procreate, che mi ha aperto un mondo infinito di possibilità creative.

teacher.aboutMe:
Hola! me voy a presentar! Soy Carol, una amante del mundo creativo, que lleva en el adn la pasión por el Diy, por la decoración, y el bricolaje, pero si hay algo que me encanta dentro de la decoración, que destaca por encima de todo y en lo que llevo años especializándome, es en el maravilloso mundo del papel pintado!

He tenido la suerte de convertir mi pasión en mi profesión! He trabajado muchos años en el mundo de la moda, y el escaparatismo, y un cambio de rumbo me llevó al mundo de la decoración, donde trabajo como freelance creando contenido creativo para marcas en mis RRSS, y también trabajo por cuenta ajena en una empresa de interiorismo llamada "Creación de Espacios" , donde en todos mis proyectos de decoración,  me caracterizo por utilizar siempre que puedo papeles pintados o murales en mis proyectos, ya que para mí es la manera mas fácil de dar un cambio radical a cualquier estancia en muy poco tiempo, sin apenas obras y llenándola de personalidad!

El mundo del papel pintado y sus posibilidades decorativas son infinitas, por lo que puedes llegar a revestir todo tipo de superficies, utilizando multitud de colores, estampados, y diferentes materiales para crear mil y un estilo únicos!
Y como buena Diyer, no solo ideo el proyecto, sino que también me he especializado en la instalación del papel pintado, por lo que disfruto tanto de la idea y búsqueda del diseño del papel o mural adecuado para cada proyecto como instalándolo!

Muestro cada dia esa pasión que siento por la creatividad y el diy, en mi Instagram @hadasycuscus y en mi web con la que llevo creando contenido digital desde 2010, así que estoy segura que todo ese contenido  te ayudará si quieres iniciarte en el mundo del Diy!
Asi que si te animas a seguirme, estoy segura que tu también podrás llegar a ser un autentico crack del Diy, el bricolaje y la decoracion! Espero que nos inspiremos juntos! Yo estoy lista a enseñarte mis trucos!  y tu... ¿estas listo para sacar lo mejor de ti?

Gudy works with design and sales teams across the lifestyle industry to clarify their vision on future communication and product strategies, sharing trend knowledge that will be translated into new product lines and services based on in-depth studies.

As an experienced keynote speaker, Gudy appears on international trade and award shows and teaches at design and art academies.
Her clients have included IKEA, Mango, Montblanc, Grohe, Samsung, NCS, Hyundai, Cosentino,IMM Cologne, European Institute of Design (IED), and Barcelona Design Week, among others.

teacher.aboutMe:
John Gall is a designer, artist, author, editor and teacher. He is currently SVP, Creative Director for the Knopf Doubleday Publishing Group. His design and illustration work for Knopf, Vintage Books, Abrams Books, The New York Times, The New Yorker, The Criterion Collection, and Nonesuch Records has been recognized by the AIGA, Art Directors Club, Print, Graphis, and American Illustration. Known for his book cover designs for such authors as Haruki Murakami, Jennifer Egan and Vladimir Nabokov, his work is featured in the books By Its Cover: Modern American Book Cover Design, and Graphic: Inside the Sketchbooks of the World's Great Graphic Designers. 

He has written about graphic design covering an array of topics from the history of Grove Press to contemporary skateboard graphics and is the author of Sayonara Home Run! The Art of the Japanese Baseball Card. He has also been the editor of two bestselling design books: Pretty Much Everything by Aaron Draplin and Sunday Sketching by Christoph Niemann. An internationally exhibited artist, a book of his personal work John Gall Collages 2008-2018 was published in 2018. He has served on the board of AIGA/NY, as an adjunct professor at the School of Visual Arts and is a frequent lecturer.

I am a craftsperson working primarily in cast water-based materials. I relocated from New Zealand to the UK in 2009, when I established my London-based studio. I make a range of objects and commissioned pieces in-house. 
My objects are often assumed to be made by 3D printing or CNC routing, but they are all handmade. I create objects whose complex forms belie the hand-made, lo-fi processes by which they are made.
Over the past ten years, my work has garnered international press, awards, and attention. Highlights include the success of my 2012 'Faceture project' that was nominated in the annual 'Designs of the Year' awards at London's Design Museum in 2013, and a Barbican exhibition and residency in 2019.
My work features regularly in international publications including ELLE Decoration, Wallpaper*, ICON, Disegno, dezeen.com and huffingtonpost.com.

teacher.aboutMe:
Ciao!
Mi chiamo Roberta e mi definisco un'archigiana dei fiori.
"Archigiana" è un gioco di parole che racchiude ciò che sono stata (un' architetto) e ciò che sono (un'artigiana).

Laureata in ingegneria edile-architettura, ho lavorato per dieci anni come designer d'interni: era un lavoro che adoravo, ma che mi costringeva quasi tutto il giorno davanti ad un computer. Mi è sempre mancato non poter svolgere un lavoro manuale e poter lavorare all'aria aperta.

Così nel 2015, dopo essere diventata mamma di due bimbi, ho deciso di lasciare il mio lavoro e d'iscrivermi ad un coso base per fiorai, che ho frequentato nella primavera del 2016.
A Settembre 2016 ho aperto un piccolo negozio di fiori a Bergamo, che mi ha permesso d'iniziare a lavorare e di conoscere sempre meglio questo mondo. Ho iniziato pian piano ad occuparmi di allestimenti di matrimoni e, parallelamente, a cercare di farmi conoscere anche fuori dalla mia città utilizzando Instagram. Grazie a questo social, ho iniziato a spedire i miei prodotti in tutta Italia -prevalentemente ghirlande- e nel 2019 ho capito che potevo provare a chiudere il negozio per aprire uno shop online.

Dal 2019 ho, infatti, un laboratorio a casa, dove realizzo e spedisco i miei prodotti, prevalentemente con fiori secchi,  e dove progetto e preparo gli allestimenti. Dall'Autunno alla Primavera, inoltre, organizzo numerosi workshop di ghirlande.

Dal 2021 ho deciso di abbandonare i fiori recisi (tranne che per bouquet e accessori) per una scelta più green e di lavorare prevalentemente con le piante e con i fiori secchi, che non devono essere buttati alla fine dell'evento. Per questo motivo sono sempre alla continua ricerca di fornitori di fiori secchi, allo scopo di poter proporre ghirlande sempre diverse e particolari.

Insomma, il mio lavoro è in continua evoluzione...

teacher.aboutMe: A pesar de crecer rodeada de libros, tuve muchas dificultades para aprender a leer. No podía hilar “Mi mamá me mima” cuando lo veía escrito. Me sentía frustrada pero mi madre Iris me enseñó con mucha paciencia y, poco después, estaba leyendo historias de piratas con mi abuela Lourdes. Me fasciné y, desde entonces, soy una acumuladora de libros. Comencé a escribir como parte de una clase en cuarto de primaria. El profesor Rafael nos pidió llevar un diario y, así, pude plasmar mis pensamientos de niña que, básicamente, eran los alimentos que me gustaban (quesos y chocolates) y lo que no (hígado encebollado). De adolescente, imprimieron mis textos novatos en un periódico local y a los 19 años publiqué mi primer libro. Creo fervientemente que los géneros literarios son intercambiables y se pueden mezclar por lo que mi escritura es híbrida. Como el lenguaje (o los lenguajes) es (son) el elemento central de mi exploración, mi proceso creativo es, ante todo, un juego. Tengo más de diez libros publicados (algunos de ellos han obtenido premios) y he sido escritora residente en lugares como la Universidad de Iowa. Actualmente soy editora titular de la revista Este País y doy clases de escritura creativa como la que encuentras aquí, en Domestika.

teacher.aboutMe: I am a watercolour artist and author of Painting Calm, based in Liverpool, UK. Originally from Lithuania, I have graduated from Vilnius Academy of Arts where I did a BA and MA degree studies in Graphic design. Throughout my studies, I've spent one semester in Paris École Estienne, where I dipped into many new disciplines like illustration, graphic art, bookbinding and eventually I rediscovered the enjoyment of hand drawing and painting. Although art has always been a big part of my life, I didn't pick up a brush until 2018 when I was on maternity leave. In the beginning, I did a 100-day project, where I painted one watercolour sketch a day in my sketchbooks for 100 days and I documented this  journey on my Instagram page. During this time, I learned so much about colour, painting, and myself, my relation to this medium, and the process. I started noticing things I like, and analysing why I like them, what feelings they bring to me, and then I tried to repeat the feeling through art. I started spending more time on paintings and doing larger pieces of works. I draw inspiration from many things, but I am mostly drawn to nature and natural objects, I like to explore motion as well as experimenting with geometry and different shapes.

teacher.aboutMe:
Jodie Ruffle is an embroidery and embellishment designer for the fashion industry, living and working in East London. After graduating from a BA in Fashion and working in industry as a designer/maker, Jodie realised her true calling was in textiles and went on to study Couture Embellishment and MA Fashion, specialising in embroidery. Since graduating, Jodie has worked with brands including Alexander McQueen, Ashish, &Daughter, Kurt Geiger and Mih Jeans as well as collaborating with menswear brand Parc London, embroidery designer Ellie Mac and textile company DMC. 

Jodie has a strong belief in the therapeutic powers of handcraft as well as the emotional and cultural value it gives to garments and objects. Working with a sustainable ethos and upcycling materials wherever she can has led to her working closely with Fashion Revolution, as an individual designer and also as a founding member of fashion collective, CONGREGATIONdesign. Her personal work focusses on deconstructing traditional haute couture embroidery and embellishment techniques and combining the imperfect, deconstructed stitch with meticulously placed sequins and beads onto upcycled garments. You can follow Jodie’s work and pieces for sale on her Instagram @jodieruffle

teacher.aboutMe:
Hi! I’m Sarah Louise Matthews and I’m a freelance paper engineer, paper cut designer and published author based in Yorkshire, England. I work with a variety of brands and clients to design and create diverse, bespoke layered papercuts and 3D paper sculptures for a broad range of commissions - from small, detailed paper sets and props to be used for styling product photography, to oversized, tactile papercrafted window displays, the scope of my work ranges hugely but I always keep paper craftsmanship and a sense of fun at the heart of what I do.

My playful paper pieces have been commissioned by brands including Bentley, Ted Baker, Clive Christian, Sipsmith and Olivia Burton, to name a few, and my work has adorned the windows of stores including Selfridges and Pandora on Oxford Street, London. On top of creating bespoke commissions for brands, I have also run papercraft workshops, written a book ‘Paper Craft Home’, published by Search Press, and contributed many papercraft projects to craft magazine Mollie Makes.

‘Paper Engineer’ would probably have been my dream job as a child, had I known of its existence, as I have vivid childhood memories of hours spent folding origami penguins and making handmade pop up books. I graduated from my Textile Surface Design Degree in 2011 with a range of folded paper jewellery and have been building on my skills through endless experimentation ever since. I am now a full time freelance Paper Engineer, spending my days buried under paper working on commissions in my studio in Yorkshire. You can keep an eye on my latest creations on my instagram @_sarah_matthews

teacher.aboutMe:
Soy una diseñadora autodidacta nacida en Lima, Perú. 

Aunque fui amante de las manualidades desde muy pequeña, después de crear el tocado de boda de mi hermana, descubrí la pasión por el diseño y la joyería fundando así mi marca homónima en 1997.

Mi maravilloso equipo de expertas artesanas y yo desarrollamos nuestra creatividad creando piezas únicas a mano usando diversas técnicas. Cada colección refleja los 24 años de conocimientos y búsqueda conceptual. Nuestro arte va más allá de trenzar el alambre. Trenzamos vínculos y creamos objetos que dan valor y significado a la historia de otras mujeres distinguiéndolas y empoderándolas.


Roxana Pardo is a self-taught designer born in Lima, Peru.

From a very young age she was a lover of crafts, after creating the wedding headdress for her sister, she discovered her passion for design and jewelry, founding her eponymous brand in 1997.

Her wonderful team of expert craftswomen and her develop their creativity by making unique pieces by hand using various techniques.

Each collection reflects 24 years of knowledge and conceptual research. Roxana Pardo's art goes beyond braiding the wire. They braid links and create objects that give value and meaning to the history of other women, distinguishing and empowering them.

Her innovative spirit and her commitment to the highest quality materials and production techniques, in each piece that she bears her signature, continue to be the hallmark of Roxana Pardo today.

teacher.aboutMe:
(Deutsche Übersetzung -> scroll nach unten) 

I am an illustrator and pleinairpainter from Frankfurt/Germany.
I started to paint 'en plein air', – outdoors on location – with oil paints as a balance to my purely digital work as an illustrator. This was literally an eye-opener for me, a mind changer in my creating process!
Everything I learn about colour, moods and light I try to incorporate into my digital painting style.

In May 2020 my German book ‚Mal einfach draußen’ about plein air painting was published, with which I want to share my enthusiasm with as many people as possible to motivate them to paint outside.

I also give plein-air workhops: individual courses in the Region around Frankfurt and also   one-week painting trips organized by artistravel.

My latest project is the website Pleinairmalerei.de. This is a platform that I created, where everyone who paints outdoors here in Germany, Austria or Switzerland can show his work, find, exchange and network with other pleinairpainters.

And finally I am here on Domestika as a teacher, to show you everything I know about pleinair painting and to inspire you to build up your studio outdoors.

Stay tuned... !

Ich bin Illustratorin und Pleinairmalerin aus Frankfurt am Main.
Als Ausgleich zu meiner rein digitalen Arbeit als Illustratorin habe ich angefangen, "en plein air", also draußen vor Ort, mit Ölfarben zu malen. Das hat mir buchstäblich die Augen geöffnet und meinen Schaffensprozess grundlegend verändert!
Alles, was ich über Farben, Stimmungen und Licht lerne, versuche ich auch in meinen digitalen Malstil einzubauen.

Im Mai 2020 erschien mein Buch 'Mal einfach draußen' über die Pleinairmalerei, mit dem ich meine Begeisterung mit möglichst vielen Menschen teilen möchte, um sie zu motivieren, draußen zu malen.

Ich gebe auch Pleinair-Workshops: individuelle Kurse und Gruppen-Workshops in der Region um Frankfurt und auch einwöchige Malreisen, die von artistravel organisiert werden.

Mein neuestes Projekt ist die Website Pleinairmalerei.de. Das ist eine Plattform, die ich ins Leben gerufen habe, auf der jeder, der hier in Deutschland, Österreich oder der Schweiz draußen malt, seine Arbeiten zeigen, andere Pleinairmaler finden, sich austauschen und vernetzen kann.

Und schließlich bin ich hier auf Domestika als Lehrerin, um Euch alles zu zeigen, was ich über Pleinairmalerei weiß und um Euch zu inspirieren, euer Atelier ebenfalls im Freien aufzubauen.

teacher.aboutMe:
We are Jack Bibbings and Matthew Hensby. We make contemporary wooden furniture from our workshop in London with a focus on using hand tools to produce practical everyday pieces suited to contemporary homes. 

Much of our work is characterised by the tools we use. We work predominantly with hand tools because of the warmth and individuality they impart and where the judgement and skill required means that things are never predictable and without challenge. This approach contributes significantly to the feel of what we make.

Rather than producing modern furniture using modern processes, or traditional processes to produce traditional designs, we marry traditional craft with contemporary design to make work that feels grounded and relevant.

teacher.aboutMe:
Nim is director and co founder of nimtim architects, starting the practice in 2014 alongside Tim. Nimi brings energy, positivity and sense of adventure to everything she does.
Nimi is a qualified garden and landscape designer. A UK qualified architect since 2008, she has worked for some of London’s most highly regarded practices including Penoyre & Prasad and Hawkins/ Brown where she was a project architect for Corby Cube and other significant developments such as Metropolitan Wharf in Wapping. Most recently prior to nimtim, Nimi was project architect on the multi-million pound Duke Street redevelopment in Mayfair for Grosvenor Estates.
Nimi is a member of the Design South East Panel and Frame Projects, sitting on London Borough of Camden and Barking & Dagenham Panels. These multi-disciplinary panels are made up of leading construction professionals and provide a clear, constructive and consistent voice on design quality in the built environment for London Local Authorities and SE England. Nimi is also a judge for the Architect’s Journal Architecture Awards as well as part of the RIBA steering group for Guerrilla Tactics, an annual creative business conference for small and medium sized architectural practices. She is passionate about promoting diversity within the profession and as well as participating in workshops for schools, she is a mentor for Blueprint For All charity and a member of Paradigm Network. 


Tim is director and co-founder of nimtim architects, starting the practice in 2014 alongside Nim. His sensitive, playful and pragmatic approach to architecture has helped shape the practice and the work it has produced.
A UK qualified architect since 2008; Tim has worked at OMA in Rotterdam and David Chipperfield architects in London. Prior to setting up nimtim architects, Tim was senior architect at RCKa where he was project architect for the RIBA award-winning TNG Youth Centre in Lewisham in addition to a number of social housing projects.
Tim studied at Oxford Brookes University, the Bauhaus Universtat and the University of Westminster where he was awarded the RIBA dissertation prize. Before taking a break to adopt his young daughter, Tim taught at UCA Canterbury and University of Reading. He continues to write on architecture and the practice of architecture and has had articles published in academic quarterlies, architectural journals and international design magazines.

teacher.aboutMe:
Soy Paula Brecciaroli, escritora, psicóloga y co-editora en Editorial Conejos. 
Nací en Buenos Aires, Argentina, en 1976.

Publiqué las novelas Otaku (Paisanita, Buenos Aires, 2015) y Brasil (Conejos, Buenos Aires, 2011), los libros de poesía Cuarenta gotas de azufre (Santos Locos, Buenos Aires, 2021), La sinceridad de un golpe (Santos Locos, Buenos Aires, 2018) y Te traje bichos para que juegues (Textos Intrusos, Buenos Aires, 2011), el libro de relatos Pequeño Ensayo Ilustrado con ilustraciones de Pablo Rivas (BonnyClide Ediciones de Mentira, Buenos Aires, 2009) y el libro de ilustración Vaca Vaca (edición de autor, Buenos Aires, 2007).

Gracias al trabajo en la editorial fui seleccionada por el Fondo Nacional de las Artes para viajar a la Feria Internacional del Libro de Guadalajara representando a las editoriales de mi país.
Años más tarde, con otros colegas editores fundamos una cooperativa de editoriales independientes La Coop con la que viajamos a las ferias del libro más importantes de Latinoamérica.  
Trabajé para algunas revistas y como columnista de literatura en programas de radio. También participé en varias antologías y colaboré en algunas revistas. Fui prejurado y jurado en premios literarios como la Bienal de Arte Joven BA 2019 y 2021.
Hace cuatro años con otros colegas abrimos la librería La Coop especializada en publicaciones de editoriales independientes.

He sido Redactor y Director Creativo en distintas agencias de publicidad, escribiendo comerciales y campañas para todo tipo de marcas. A los veintidós años fundé Grace Navarra, mi propia agencia de publicidad.

teacher.aboutMe:
¡Hola! Soy Claudia María Gutiérrez (@cayagutierrez), ilustradora y ceramista.

Estudié comunicación social y ejercí mi profesión por varios años en el campo de la cultura.
Desde pequeña me ha gustado dibujar y me apasiona el arte. Hace algunos años me enamoré de la ilustración y me decidí a seguir ese camino, que me ha permitido explorar nuevas maneras de contar historias a través de la imagen.

Mi trabajo ha recibido reconocimientos como el I Premio Tragaluz de Ilustración (Col, 2011), mención en Latin American Illustration -LAI2- (EEUU, 2013), mención especial del jurado del Premio a la Ilustración Iberoamericana (Arg, 2013), participé en la Bienal de Ilustración de Bratislava (2015) y recibí el primer premio en el concurso de ilustración para el cartel de la campaña 'Leer en Familia' de Fundalectura (Col, 2019). En mayo 2023 una de mis piezas cerámicas en homenaje a Vermeer participó en la exposición 'My Girl with a Pearl' en el Mauritshuis Museum (La Haya) y se exhibió nuevamente en la exposición inmersiva de Fabrique des Lumières a finales del 2024 en Amsterdam.

He ilustrado libros para diversas editoriales, realizado encargos de ilustración para organizaciones públicas y privadas y desarrollado proyectos personales.

Buscando intervenir objetos con mis dibujos, hace unos años descubrí el fascinante universo de la cerámica, un oficio ancestral con posibilidades infinitas. Desde entonces procuro fusionar esos dos mundos: modelo a mano mis propias piezas y las ilustro con mis personajes, utilizando una delicada técnica muy parecida a la acuarela. El resultado son piezas únicas de uso cotidiano que se convierten en una cálida presencia para acompañar diferentes momentos del día.

Tengo dos hijos y dos gatas. Amo la naturaleza, viajar, cantar y montar en bicicleta.

teacher.aboutMe:
Soy Isabel Río, fundadora de la marca de ANTONIA’S y diseñadora con más de 15 años de experiencia profesional en diferentes países. En 2018 fundé ANTONIA'S como un proyecto de cambio de vida, después años trabajando para firmas como Alexander Wang, Calvin Klein Collection y Carolina Herrera, entre otros. 

En 2009 me mudé a EE.UU y formo parte de la segunda generación de graduados del prestigioso programa MFA Fashion Design and Society en la Escuela Parsons NY, formando parte del selecto grupo de 13 estudiantes elegidos en todo el mundo, siendo la única española en cursarlo hasta la fecha.
En mi colección presentada en la semana de la moda de NY, mis modelos llevaban alpargatas hechas por mi y ahí es donde todo empezó. Me di cuenta que estilistas e influencers estaban mucho mas interesadas en mis diseños de zapatos.

Después de viajar y vivir en diferentes partes del mundo, decidí volver a mis raíces españolas para fundar algo donde pudiese utilizar la manipulación textil de una manera innovadora, manteniendo siempre un compromiso con la autenticidad y la calidad en el trabajo. 

Crecí en un pueblo pequeño de Galicia, donde naturaleza, mar y familia están fuertemente conectados. El nombre de la firma hace referencia a mi padre y mi abuela, Antón y Antonia, ambos fallecidos en los últimos años. ANTONIA’S es un homenaje y un intento de mantenerlos a ambos cerca  y llevar su espíritu mágico en esta nueva aventura.

ANTONIA’S es humana, local, artesanal y responsable.

teacher.aboutMe:
Soy  Isabel Sanchez y hace más de cuarenta años  que me dedico a la moda.

Mi primer interés por  esta profesión  fue de carácter técnico, explorando la construcción de las prendas.

De formación autodidacta, he aprendido a base de equivocarme, de ensayar y volver a equivocarme así como de imitar a grandes referentes tales como  Balenciaga, Manuel Piña, Isey Miyake, Commes des Garçons y como no a  la genial precursora del corte al bies Madeleine Vionnete, a través de los cuales adquiero  otras formas de trabajar con los tejidos, la importancia del conocimiento y la experimentación con los mismos, la construcción de volúmenes, y la búsqueda de la excelencia a través de los detalles.


Desde finales de los años ochenta trabajo y colaboro con diseñadores españoles de gran prestigio como Devota y Lomba, Jesús del Pozo, Agatha Ruiz de la Prada. Paralelamente a partir de 1999 inicio mi carrera como docente en asignaturas técnicas de patronaje y modelaje en distintas  universidades como la universidad de Navarra, la universidad Europea de Madrid o el Instituto Europeo di Design entre otros pudiendo así volcar mi experiencia desempeñando ambos cargos  tanto en el área de creación y desarrollo  como en el de la docencia.


En 2011 se publica mi libro “19 Variaciones del Little Black Dress” también traducido al francés e italiano, en el que muestro distintas técnicas de construir el famoso vestido negro de Chanel, sin que necesariamente tengamos que recurrir al patronaje más convencional,  sino que podamos llegar tambíen a él  manipulando figuras geométricas o a través del moulage.

Ese mismo año pongo en marcha mi Laboratorio de Proyectos, un espacio creado para brindar soluciones a todas las etapas del desarrollo de los mismos, tanto técnica como conceptualmente, y donde abordo desde proyectos para desfiles a trabajos de investigación para la construcción de volúmenes y comportamiento del tejido.

Actualmente, estoy poniendo en marcha Isabel Sanchez School, un canal dedicado a la docencia online y presencial.

When the world’s leading brands need to leave a lasting impact, they turn to New York native Jon Contino. As founder and creative director of CONTINO, a no-limits independent branding studio, Jon has produced award-winning work for household names including Nike, MillerCoors, American Eagle, Coca-Cola, 20th Century Fox, AT&T, and Sports Illustrated.

His distinctive style is defined by its humanity, eschewing antiseptic lines and prefab typefaces in favor of creating emotional connections through raw, honest expression. He has built a reputation as the industry’s hardest-working designer since his mid-teens, and has over two decades of experience at the highest level. His often-imitated work has influenced a generation of designers, and helped define the modern lens through which we view our increasingly design-centric world.

Jon's ability to distill a brand down to its essence and express it through his unique blend of minimalist illustration and unmistakable hand-lettering has earned him the respect of fellow designers, creative directors, and many of the most influential minds in branding. He has received some of the industry’s most prestigious honors, including a Design & Decoration Building Stars of Design award, a Clio Key Art award, a Cannes Lion award, and ADC’s Young Guns award, just to name a few.

In 2018, Jon published his first book, Brand by Hand, in partnership with Abrams Books.

teacher.aboutMe:
Mi chiamo Nadia Leo e sono una graphic designer con un'esperienza trentennale nel campo della pubblicità, editoria, illustrazione, calligrafia e lettering. 
Collaboro con aziende di diversi settori: dalla moda, al campo alimentare, all'editoria, fino alle agenzie che organizzano eventi. 

Vivo nella campagna torinese, che amo profondamente, e dalla quale traggo quotidiana ispirazione. 
Lavoro tra Torino, Milano e Bologna.

Nel 2016 ho dato forma al progetto Manifattura Calligrafica, attraverso il quale realizzo wedding stationary, l'allestimento di set fotografici e cinematografici, packaging.
 
Nel mio lavoro integro la grafica con la mia passione per la precisione della calligrafia.
Sono un'appassionata di comunicazione visiva. Amo studiare e aggiornarmi continuamente.
 
Attraverso la grafica cerco l'equilibrio tra le forme e con la calligrafia completo in modo armonioso
gli oggetti che ritraggo. 

La pittura naturalistica è quella che mi ha rubato il cuore. Nei miei acquerelli c'è tutto il mio amore per l'osservazione della natura di cui mi piace catturare la vera essenza, concentrandomi sulla luce e sui colori.
Osservando la natura ho capito che in essa non c'è nulla di casuale. Da questo studio ho preso spunto per l'acquerello botanico che ho poi trasformato in una linea di cartoleria, biglietti di auguri, segnalibri e quaderni.

teacher.aboutMe:
Hi! My name is Katy and I am an artist and small business owner based in a small town in the UK.
When I was younger I would always dream of being creative in some shape or form. Whenever I had a chance I would always be colouring in or drawing in my sketchbook. I would always be asking my family members to rate my colouring inn pages out of 10! And let me tell you they would be very harsh! I had the amazing opportunity to go to University and graduate with a 1st class honours in Surface Pattern Design I was so happy. After getting my degree I quickly decided to get a job as an in house designer in Sheffield, where I spent nearly two years designing for Primark, Asda and Matalan. I then decided to move on to work for Ling Design which is a card company based in the UK.  I learnt so much from both of these jobs, but the biggest learning curve I learnt was that working for someone else wasn't for me. So that's when Simply, Katy was born, and now I have built up my business to be my full time job. You will find me working from my home studio, drinking lot's of coffee, illustrating on procreate and singing along to lots of 80s playlists!

teacher.aboutMe:
Designer de formation, j'ai découvert la céramique pendant des cours du soir. Je me suis passionnée pour la terre, les couleurs et les infinies possibilités de la matière. J'ai commencé à vendre mes créations et petit à petit, la céramique a fini par devenir mon métier et c'est ainsi que la marque Dodo Toucan est née ! L’univers de Dodo Toucan est comme son nom : naïf et coloré. Vivant et poétique, il s’est diversifié depuis sa création et s’est peuplé de vases, pots, animaux sauvages, grigris et autres créatures magiques. . Les formes rondes et douces de ce bestiaire ludique et coloré invitent au rêve et poétisent le quotidien.

Aujourd'hui,  je travaille, je fabrique et je crée dans mon atelier parisien, avec une petite équipe de céramistes à mes côtés. En parallèle de notre activité de création, nous donnons des cours d'initiation à la céramique, avec comme mots d'ordre le plaisir, la spontanéité et la couleur.

Hola! Mi nombre es Mairo, fotógrafo de moda desde el 2016. Aprendí fotografía registrando shows de hardcore-punk y luego fui haciendo retratos a mis amigos de esos conciertos, así me interesé por fotografiar personas.

Estudié diseño, y la fotografía de moda es el match perfecto entre retratar personas y diseñar con los elementos como el vestuario, el peinado, el maquillaje y las poses. 

Últimamente he direccionado mi trabajo a algo minimalista,  haciendo fotografías con pocos recursos, sacandole el mayor potencial posible a mis personajes y locaciones,  logrando así resultados editoriales high end listo para publicar en revistas de moda.

teacher.aboutMe:
Depuis les années 80, Ruedi Baur pense son activité de designer dans le contexte de l’espace public. Travaillant dans un premier temps comme graphiste pour de nombreuses institutions culturelles, il met en place, dès les années 90, un enseignement transdisciplinaire à l’Ensba de Lyon autour de la notion « d’espace-information » puis un post-diplôme intitulé « Espaces civiques et design ». 

Depuis, cette thématique l’occupe en permanence, aussi bien dans le cadre du travail réalisé au sein des ateliers qu'il dirige que dans le cadre de ses enseignements. Il intervient ainsi sur des problématiques liées à l'identification, à l'orientation, à la scénographie et plus largement à la représentation d'institutions, d’espaces urbains et de territoires politiques souvent aux côtés d’architectes et d’urbanistes.

Revendiquant un design interdisciplinaire, il créé en 1989 le réseau Intégral avec des implantations locales en France et en Suisse (Intégral Ruedi Baur Paris et Zurich) et poursuit, dans cet état d’esprit, son enseignement dans différentes écoles comme la Hochschule für Grafik und Buchkunst à Leipzig où il fut professeur en « System-design », avant d’être désigné Recteur de l’école. Aujourd’hui, il enseigne et développe des programmes  de recherche à la HEAD - Genève, à l'EnsAD - Paris, ainsi qu’à la faculté des arts de l’université de Strasbourg où il a dirigé la recherche-action Idex : "identités complexes, lisibilité et intelligibilité". 

A Strasbourg, il a également soutenu sa thèse intitulée « Entre Identité et identification, les valeurs civiques des systèmes de représentation territoriaux ». Docteur honoris causa en design de l’Université de Laval (Québec, Canada), il a enseigné et mis en place des recherches en Chine, en Argentine ou encore au Brésil. 

Sa bibliographie permet de suivre son parcours de chercheur, notamment avec des livres tels que « Signs for Peace, an impossible visual Encyclopedia », écrit avec Vera Baur chez Lars Müller (2012) ou « Face au brand territorial » également chez Lars Müller (2013). 

Deux ateliers basés à Paris, Integral designers et dix-milliards-humains, ainsi que l’Institut de recherche en design Civic City accompagnent aujourd’hui Ruedi Baur. Parmi les très nombreux projets de signalétique, d’identité visuelle comme de scénographie dont il est l’auteur, on retiendra, parmi les plus récents, l’identité visuelle de la Manifesta 11, la signalétique de la New School à New York, celle de l’aéroport de Cologne-Bonn ou encore de Vienne, le projet "La Phrase, projet de design urbain" durant Mons, Capitale européenne de la culture 2015, la signalétique du nouveau bâtiment de l'ONU à Genève. Avec l’équipe d’Integral designers, il conçoit en ce moment le système d’informations voyageurs des lignes du futur métro du Grand Paris (2022-2030). 

Ruedi Baur est membre de l’AGI (Alliance Graphique internationale) depuis 1992.

Somos Mike Madrid y Gabriel García, fotógrafos, diseñadores gráficos y directores de arte. 

Hace más de diez años creamos Cup of Couple, un espacio online que desde sus inicios nos sirvió para compartir nuestro trabajo y nuestro día a día con altas dósis de estética, diseño e inspiración, convirtiéndose en nuestra seña de identidad.

Al poco tiempo de empezar con nuestra web, creamos nuestra cuenta de instagram, @cupofcouple, y nuestra forma de comunicar nos sirvió para conectar con personas y marcas. Instagram nos ha dado la oportunidad de trabajar con marcas que admiramos y de viajar por todo el planeta. Hemos impartido clases de fotografía en escuelas como IED Madrid y para marcas como Canon.

Actualmente, combinamos nuestro trabajo como fotógrafos con la creación de contenidos y gestión de redes sociales para marcas.

Depuis 2018, j’ai eu plus de 200 élèves dans mes formations Instagram, et accompagné plus de 50 entrepreneurs en individuel.

teacher.aboutMe:
I have been telling stories my whole life. My professional career has taken me to theatre, TV, film and children's literature. I write middle-grade adventure and fantasy books for readers aged 8-12 and plays for the whole family to enjoy. My books are being adapted for stage and screen and have been translated into 14 languages, including Brazilian, Italian and Spanish.

Telling stories is one of the most natural human activities; it comes to us naturally as breathing. However, it can seem more complex and mysterious than it is, although there is always an element of magic to any great story. I aim to demystify that process and show that anyone can write with the right tools and strategies. We all have at least one great story inside us.

I have been teaching children and adults to write for eight years, using skills I have learned from my training at The Novelry, The Arvon Creative Writing Foundation, and the City Lit University, as well as insights I have gained through my practice and those shared with me by fellow writers. I have taught creative writing globally, from the USA to China, and I look forward to sharing what I have learned on that journey here.

My books include The Last Wild (shortlisted for the Waterstones Children's Book Prize), The Dark Wild (Guardian Children's Fiction Prize), The Lost Magician (Teach Primary Book Award) and the Midnight Treasure series (Waterstones Children's Book of the Month. My latest book is Tree Thing.

I have also adapted several classic family stories for theatre, including the world premiere stage version of John Masefield's The Box of Delights for the RSC in Stratford, Christmas Carol by Charles Dickens (featuring the first female Scrooge on the London stage) and The Wind in the Willows by Kenneth Grahame ( for Wiltons' Music Hall, London)

Me gradué como psicólogo por la Universidad de Lima, y luego de trabajar en un banco decidí tomarme un año libre para dedicarme a escribir. Para mi sorpresa, ese mismo año quedé doble finalista en el premio de literatura infantil El Barco de Vapor - Perú 2011. No gané, pero la buena recepción de mis manuscritos me dio el impulso para volver a participar al año siguiente.  Fue así como escribí el libro Simón, con el cual finalmente logré hacerme del primer lugar. Desde el año 2011 hasta el 2016 escribí variedad de libros infantiles y juveniles, algunos de los cuales fueron publicados por editoriales como Planeta, Bruño, Norma, Ediciones SM y Meraki. Hoy en día resido en Frankfurt-Alemania, donde sigo aprovechando mis momentos libres para escribir.

teacher.aboutMe:
Mi nombre es Dácil Fernández y me dedico a la fotografía gastronómica. Nací en Tenerife aunque llevo muchos años viviendo en Madrid, tantos que ya ni acento tengo.

Mi pasión por el mundo de la fotografía llegó a través de un blog de repostería, donde lo que menos hacía era redactar una receta. La mayoría de las veces me inventaba historias donde daba rienda suelta a mi vena narrativa y lo culminaba con el momento de las fotos. Con el tiempo empecé a darme cuenta de que aquellos postres eran la excusa, pero la fotografía era el fin. A partir de ahí, comencé a tomármelo más en serio y decidí comenzar a formarme. Empecé mis estudios de fotografía en una conocida escuela de Madrid, aunque debo confesar que nunca los finalicé. Por allí se empeñaban en enseñarme la velocidad de sincronización del flash, y yo soñaba con mantener un tórrido romance con el color y la composición. Así que se podría decir que casi todo lo que se, lo he aprendido a fuerza de apretar mucho el botón de mi cámara.

Después llegó el momento de tomar una de las decisiones más importantes de mi vida, dejar mi trabajo  de estilista de moda para dedicarme de lleno a la fotografía. Mi escaparate y trampolín inicial fué Instagram,  puedo decir que a esta red social se lo debo casi todo. Comencé a publicar mis proyectos personales y poco a poco las marcas y clientes se fueron interesando en mi trabajo. Mi primer trabajo “serio” me llegó a los 15 días de abrir la cuenta. 
He trabajado con diversas marcas del sector como: Mangaroca. Dyc, Tefal, Keenwood, Nescafé, Paulaner, Buldog, y Lidl entre otras. Todas llegaron a mi a través de INSTAGRAM

Siempre estoy en continuo y constante aprendizaje, bien sea a través de libros, cursos, talleres...Me parece fundamental no solo para avanzar en tu crecimiento como profesional, sino para tener también la perspectiva de otros profesionales  y entender su visión de la fotografía.
Y esa es intención principal como profesora de Domestika, enseñarte mi propia visión de de la fotografía gastronómica. Al final, cualquiera profesional puede explicarte el triángulo de la exposición y las reglas de composición, pero lo realmente importante y enriquecedor es entender la manera en que estos lo trabajan y lo aplican. 

Espero poder charlar contigo muy pronto a través del foro. Un abrazo y hasta pronto!

teacher.aboutMe: Bonjour ! Je suis Jean Mallard, un illustrateur qui vit et travaille à Paris. J'ai commencé à dessiner enfant, et je ne me suis plus jamais arrêté. Aujourd'hui c'est mon métier, et je travaille sur différents projets de livres, d'expositions, de peintures et de commandes diverses et variées. Depuis plusieurs années je développe mon écriture graphique, autour de la couleur et de la peinture à l'eau, essentiellement l'aquarelle et de la gouache. Ce sont des techniques très simples, mais qui me permettent de créer des mondes colorés infinis et de raconter toutes sortes d'histoires. C'est ce que j'aime le plus avec l'illustration : c'est un superbe outil narratif, universel, avec le quel on peut créer des récits sans parole et d'une liberté totale. J'ai vécu pendant un moment à Naples, ce qui a donné vie à ma première exposition, en m'inspirant de mes promenades et de mes rencontres et des choses qu'on me racontait.

Sarah Margaret is a contemporary realist artist, specializing in portraits of people and of birds. Characterized by a rich tenebrism, Gibson’s work dramatically juxtaposes light against shadow. She believes that light, and all of its symbolic qualities, are most poetic when contrasted against dark. Building up her paintings from a series layers—contrasting heavy impastos against thin, delicate passages—she seeks to give her works a palpable depth and complexity. She aims to capture the personality and the life-force of her subjects, and to give the viewer a riot of details and varying textures, so that they can find something new to contemplate on each viewing. 

Originally from Cincinnati, Ohio, Gibson received her formal training in drawing and painting in Florence, Italy, where she studied at the Angel Academy of Art and then The Florence Academy of Art, from which she graduated in 2013. She taught at the Florence Academy's intermediate studio from 2012-2015.  
Gibson currently lives on the West coast of Scotland, where she has her private studio. In 2019 she co-founded the Glasgow Academy of Fine Art along with her husband, where she acts as Academic Director. Gibson's work is shown throughout the U.S. and Europe and can be found in the New Britain Museum of American Art and in numerous private collections.
