Sou jornalista formada pela Faculdade Cásper Líbero, com pós-graduação em Marketing de Serviços (FAAP) e Gastronomia: História e Cultura (Senac). Tenho 20 anos de experiência em estratégias de comunicação e conteúdo. Também sou autora do livro Cozinha Pop - As 100 melhores cenas gastronômicas do cinema e séries de TV, lançado em 2014 pela editora Panda Books.

Em 2017, comecei a atuar em empresas de tecnologia. Primeiro, no iFood, onde fiz curadoria de conteúdo da homepage do app; criação e manutenção das diretrizes de tom e voz e estilo de escrita para o produto, assegurando voz e identidade consistentes para a marca; estratégia de conteúdo no projeto de concepção do novo app do iFood, trabalhando junto aos designers, gerentes de produto, pesquisadores e desenvolvedores.

Depois, fui para a Loggi, onde estou como Gerente Sênior de Design de Conteúdo, fazendo a ponte entre Produto e Marca e liderando um time de dez pessoas de três diferentes disciplinas (UX Writing, Technical Writing e Estratégia de Conteúdo) em diferentes unidades de negócio.

Nessa função, sou responsável por definir a estratégia de conteúdo para um novo produto; direcionamento e alinhamento de uma visão de conteúdo abrangente para gerar consistência na comunicação e assegurar uma percepção única para Marca e Produto; mentoria e desenvolvimento de Content Design Leads responsáveis pela estratégia de conteúdo e a gestão de Content Designers em diferentes unidades de negócio; sistematização, governança e disseminação dos produtos de Content Design (guia de escrita e glossário).

teacher.aboutMe:
Sou designer com mais de 20 anos de experiência nas mais diversas áreas, do Digital e User Experience, ao Branding e Publicidade. 

Comecei a aprender caligrafia por conta própria em 2007, depois de fazer minhas próprias ferramentas – uma pena de bambu e uma Cola Pen, e desde então continuo estudando com alguns dos melhores artistas e mestres do Brasil e do mundo, como Andréa Branco, Cláudio Gil, Luca Barcellona, John Stevens, Julian Waters e tantos outros.

Em 2014 comecei a trabalhar com lettering e caligrafia aplicados a projetos de design, publicidade e arte e já trabalhei com clientes e marcas como Tiffany & Co., Natura, Boticário, Ambev, EDP e PagSeguro.

Além do trabalho comercial em ações de caligrafia, design editorial e projetos de identidade, me dedico ao estudo das letras e palavras aplicadas como imagem, através de projetos pessoais autorais e encomendas de quadros e letterings para tatuagens.

Já participei de 3 exposições, incluindo uma solo onde exibi o resultado de estudos sobre de caligrafia abstrata que exploram os limites da linguagem verbal e visual, e o potencial do gesto como linguagem, com caligrafia assêmica e composições gestuais. 

No meu trabalho, busco sempre criar letras que comunicam além do que está escrito, com personalidade, tom de voz e energia. Sejam elas escritas ou desenhadas, eu acredito que as letras podem, e devem evoluir tanto esteticamente quanto no seu potencial expressivo.

I also create frames for individual clients who want to decorate their homes in their own taste and style. I am a Certified Framer with the Fine Art Trade Guild, and am continually learning about new techniques in the field of conservation framing. I love creating extra-special finishes for frames, including gilding, gessoing, distressing, and selecting bespoke colour combinations to suit each work that comes into my studio.

I love to paint watercolours and gild and reverse paint on glass, so often frame my own work.

I believe in the power of art to transform a space - no matter how cheap or expensive it is. There is nothing more bleak than a completely blank and unadorned wall. When I was an art student and my budget was tight, I was creating loads of paintings and collecting inspirational images to decorate my home. I wish I had known then how easy it would be to create my own frames to display things in a more preservation-minded and professional way, so now I do hope to spread some knowledge on the basics of framing to others.

teacher.aboutMe:
Soy un diseñador gráfico, originario del Estado de Morelos y radicando en la enorme y complicada Ciudad de México. Actualmente me encuentro desarrollando proyectos originales para animación y cómic, los cuales han ganado premios en festivales como Pixelatl en México y Ventana Sur en Argentina, y se han presentado en otros más como Premios Quirino en España y Annecy en Francia.

A lo largo de los años he incursionado en distintas áreas lo que me ha llevado a participar en todo tipo de proyectos:

Trabajé en ilustración editorial para libros educativos de la SEP y Editorial Castillo/MacMillan, además de revistas como Gentleman, Travel and Leisure, y muchas otras. En Animación he realizado proyectos con Estudios como Ánima y Fotosíntesis, diseñando personajes y pintando fondos. También he trabajado en campañas publicitarias para Kraken Rum, Martí, Freefire y Buzzfeed. He colaborado con marcas como Moleskine y Wacom dando talleres además de dar clases en Escuela Escena y Coco School México. Y algo que pocos saben es que he estado tatuando por más de 6 años y es algo que disfruto muchísimo.

En los últimos años he estado persiguiendo mi interés por contar historias y experimentando con diferentes medios para hacerlo. En 2020 empecé el proyecto "San Misterio" junto a Ari Navarrete, el cuál ganó Ideatoon en Pixelatl y un par de premios más en el festival Ventana Sur y actualmente estamos en el proceso de publicar la segunda novela gráfica. Y en 2019 escribí y dibujé el comic "La Canción del Lago" que ganó Secuenciarte en Festival Pixelatl y que en 2023 se convirtió en un corto animado que lleva más de 20 selecciones oficiales, un par de premios y nominaciones a las Diosas de Plata y los Arieles.

Me emociona mucho la exploración y la creación;  espero seguir en éste camino por mucho tiempo.

teacher.aboutMe:
Hola somos Laura y Ana, hermanas creadoras de la marca VATTEA, nuestra pasión por la artesania y el diseño nos llevo a estudiar nuestras carreras,  producción de joyería y diseño industrial respectivamente. En el año 2016 consolidamos nuestra marca de joyas en la ciudad de Medellín (Colombia).

Creamos cada pieza con gran cuidado en los detalles y procesos manuales, el trabajo con los hilos cocidos a mano y almidonados es el resultado de un proceso de investigación con féculas naturales. La exploración de materiales es parte del proceso creativo en nuestro taller, nos encanta descubrir todo lo que se puede lograr inteviniendolos... cortar, soldar, enrollar... ¡infinidad de posibilidades!

Nos inspiramos en diversas culturas ancestrales y sus representaciones a través de objetos y símbolos, tomamos los colores como referentes del folclor colombiano evocando la calidez y fuerza de las mujeres latinas.
 
El material base de VATTEA es el bronce. A cada pieza le damos una textura o pulido para dar este efecto de rusticidad que se ve en nuestras joyas, posteriormente cada pieza es bañada en oro de 24 quilates. El hilo de algodón es otro de los materiales que caracteriza a la marca, este pasa por procesos como la costura a mano y luego un almidonado con féculas naturales. El resultado son piezas con gran valor artesanal.

Nuestras joyas han sido publicadas en revistas como Vogue Latinoamerica, Caras Colombia, Carrusel, Aló entre otras.

Hola, mi nombre es Camilo y soy un dibujante. La palabra 'dibujante' me gusta más que 'ilustrador' porque me hace pensar en sencillez -un papel y un lápiz- y en intimidad. Así definiría mi trabajo: sencillo e íntimo.

Llevo un buen tiempo dibujando, desde que tengo memoria he rayado las esquinas de mis cuadernos y he tenido libretas secretas. Pensaba que -en mí- el dibujo era un talento menor pero hace unos años me animé a registrar y compartir mi trabajo y desde entonces, poco a poco, ha alcanzado visibilidad y respuesta, mientras que he crecido y creído más en esta posibilidad.

Al dibujar busco hacer traducciones poéticas de mi experiencia cotidiana. Valoro la economía del lenguaje, la musicalidad (amo la poesía y la música). Mi obra tiene un corte autobiográfico, si bien me permito ficcionar, estirar, sacudir mi experiencia vital para hacer dibujos y cómics.

teacher.aboutMe:
I have been telling stories my whole life. My professional career has taken me to theatre, TV, film and children's literature. I write middle-grade adventure and fantasy books for readers aged 8-12 and plays for the whole family to enjoy. My books are being adapted for stage and screen and have been translated into 14 languages, including Brazilian, Italian and Spanish.

Telling stories is one of the most natural human activities; it comes to us naturally as breathing. However, it can seem more complex and mysterious than it is, although there is always an element of magic to any great story. I aim to demystify that process and show that anyone can write with the right tools and strategies. We all have at least one great story inside us.

I have been teaching children and adults to write for eight years, using skills I have learned from my training at The Novelry, The Arvon Creative Writing Foundation, and the City Lit University, as well as insights I have gained through my practice and those shared with me by fellow writers. I have taught creative writing globally, from the USA to China, and I look forward to sharing what I have learned on that journey here.

My books include The Last Wild (shortlisted for the Waterstones Children's Book Prize), The Dark Wild (Guardian Children's Fiction Prize), The Lost Magician (Teach Primary Book Award) and the Midnight Treasure series (Waterstones Children's Book of the Month. My latest book is Tree Thing.

I have also adapted several classic family stories for theatre, including the world premiere stage version of John Masefield's The Box of Delights for the RSC in Stratford, Christmas Carol by Charles Dickens (featuring the first female Scrooge on the London stage) and The Wind in the Willows by Kenneth Grahame ( for Wiltons' Music Hall, London)

teacher.aboutMe:
¡Hola! 
Soy Animador de Personajes y generalista 3D de origen mexicano, actualmente radico en Aguascalientes, México. 
Llevo quince años trabajando en el medio, desde empezando haciendo Motion Graphics, para después concentrarme como generalista 3D, aunque mi meta y enfoque principal siempre fué la animación. 
Después de trabajar en estudios locales, mi primer trabajo nacional y mi primer película, fué la tercer película de Huevocartoon, titulada "Un Gallo con Muchos Huevos", en donde entré como artista de FX, pero me dieron la oportunidad y animé algunas tomas también. Gracias a eso, empecé a tomar trabajos profesionales como animador, mayormente como Freelance. 
Estuve un año en Canadá en el estudio Bardel como artista de FX en la serie de Puss in Boots de Netflix y después trabajé en otros estudios como animador, ya de regreso en México, como Metacube y Boxel. 
Despúes entré ya como animador, de regreso a Huevocartoon con las películas "Un Rescate de Huevitos" y "un Gallo Congelado".
En los dos últimos años he trabajado tiempo completo como animador freelance, donde puedo comentar trabajos con Secret Location, estudio americano de videojuegos, Ploop, estudio de publicidad en México y Brape, estudio de producción en Brasil. También comencé mi canal de Youtube, llamado Cebolla Skin, y empecé a dar clases personales en línea.
Es en éstos años y a partir de los proyectos de Secret Location, que empecé a usar Blender y lo adopté como mi software de trabajo base y predilecto personalmente, utilizándolo todos los días, para trabajo profesional y personal. Ya lo usaba desde años atrás para hacer modelado, escultura y uvs, pero el dar el salto para Animación de Personajes, me hizo llevarme una muy grata sorpresa, al descubrir su gran comodidad y velocidad para trabajar.

Hola! Mi nombre es Daniela Chiñas, soy diseñadora y artista textil. Soy originaria de San Cristóbal de las casas, Chiapas y de Oaxaca, por lo que desde muy chica estuve sumergida en el mundo textil, ya que estas dos partes de México cuentan con una riqueza cultural textil muy extensa. Considero esto como el precursor por mi interés en proyectos de arte y diseño mediante diferentes técnicas artesanales, ocupando diferentes medios, sobre todo los textiles.

Teniendo como base la carrera de Diseño Textil, empecé a explorar las diferentes posibilidades de este material y comencé con mi proyecto personal Daāch. Proyecto que me ha permitido relacionarme con diferentes técnicas creativas y artesanales para comunicar de diferentes maneras, ideas y emociones a través de los materiales, técnicas, pigmentos y texturas.

El objetivo de Daāch, es revalorizar el trabajo artesanal y de oficios en los tiempos actuales, donde los medios industriales y tecnológicos han cambiado la percepción de los trabajos hechos a mano, dándoles el valor que realmente merecen, tanto de manera histórica, social y económica. Permitiéndome trabajar tanto de manera personal como colectiva.

teacher.aboutMe:
Elsa Tierney is a London-based jeweller, artist and author specialising in wax carving and Mitsuro Hikime techniques to create sculptural jewellery. Her fascination with wax as a creative medium has led her to author two books, Art of Wax and Mitsuro Hikime: Japanese Wax Sculpting, both of which have become valued resources for jewellers and artists exploring these techniques.


Alongside her own creative practice, Elsa teaches wax carving and Mitsuro Hikime at the Goldsmiths’ Centre and offers private one-to-one tuition in both disciplines. She has exhibited at Goldsmiths’ Fair and has received multiple awards from the Goldsmiths’ Crafts & Design Council in recognition of her craftsmanship.


With over 15 years of professional experience, Elsa has built a diverse career encompassing jewellery design and making, selling through markets, pop-ups, fairs and online platforms, promoting her work through social media, teaching both private and group workshops, and working closely with suppliers and specialist services across the jewellery industry.


Elsa's work is rooted in her background in fine art and is inspired by the artists of 1930s Paris, including Brancusi, Man Ray and Picasso, as well as the elegance of Art Deco. She also draws inspiration from the abstract bronze sculptures of Henry Moore and Barbara Hepworth, alongside African art and the ancient treasures housed in museums such as the V&A and the British Museum. She approaches each piece of jewellery as a miniature sculpture, designed not only to be worn but also appreciated as a work of art.


In addition to jewellery, Elsa applies her wax carving expertise to her fine art practice, creating wax sculptures that are cast into bronze and other metals using the traditional lost-wax casting process. Her ongoing research explores the creative possibilities of wax across both jewellery and sculpture, reflecting her commitment to pushing the boundaries of the medium.


Through her making, teaching and writing, Elsa continues to champion wax as a versatile artistic material, encouraging experimentation while sharing both traditional techniques and contemporary approaches with makers around the world.

teacher.aboutMe:
My name is Chinelo Bally, I am a fashion designer, an author, a television personality and an avid lover of all things creative and creating. I specialise in a unique method of garment production called Freehand Cutting. 

Over the past 10 years I have shared my skill with interested students and audiences all over the world. I run workshops all over the UK, regularly participate in craft exhibitions, and take part in loads of fun craft centred series for national television stations in the UK. My first television appearance was as a contestant on BBC2's "The Great British Sewing Bee" (season 2) where I came second. 

Following the success of the show, I have written 2 bestselling books, "Freehand Fashion" (2015) and "Sew Chinelo" (2021), that guides the reader step by step through the projects ensuring that makers of all abilities can participate in this thrilling craft. 

My passion for fashion design and dressmaking takes root in fund memories dotted throughout my life. From nostalgic memories of looking through my mum's wardrobes and trunks as a child, to walking through the narrow lanes of the fabric section of old Alade Market in 90s Lagos, playing with scrap off cuts from my mum's store to describing my desired dress to the very patient local dressmaker. I've always had a special appreciation for clothes and fabric, experimenting with embellishments and up-cycling store bought clothes. In January 2010, I decided that I was tried of ill fitting clothes that didn’t fully represent my style profile; I bought my very first sewing machine the day I decided I would start making my own clothes; and so the story began! I learnt the basics of freehand cutting from my aunty and then went on to develop my own version of the traditional African method of garment construction. 

The allure of this method is how beautifully the clothes fit. There is also the creative freedom you are afforded because the starting point isn't a pre-prescribed design by the commercial pattern company; you may chose to start off with a design in mind and stay guided or you can let it evolve organically into another amazing creation; freehand cutting is truly liberating. 

Freehand cutting help you develop a deeper understanding of how and why clothes fit the body, this understanding is essential for upgrading you dressmaking skills from basic to extraordinary. 

I like to describe my style as a celebration of the many facets of femininity, it’s s a celebration of the female form in all its variations. If you love originality, appreciate a great fit and want to freely explore and experiment with you style, then Freehand cutting is for you.

teacher.aboutMe:
'Watercolour painting is not a race, it is a search for yourself' David Poxon
David Poxon is known the world over for the precision and craftmanship of his pure watercolour paintings. He specializes in pure watercolour, and is a Watercolour Master. His paintings can take many weeks to make with multiple layers of transparent paint each one modifying the colours beneath. He has developed  special techniques h over the years to portray the illusions of texture, depth, and tonal contrast. The French biographer L Benoist described him as 'A painter architect biographer of our times'. His subject material features the overlooked, the abandoned, and discarded. The passage of time and the magical effects it creates are incorporated into David's paintings. He is a highly respected and much travelled artist and tutor . Texture and luminosity are specialities. 
He is an elected member of the exclusive Royal Institute, and also the National Watercolour Society of America. He has won many awards and is frequently invited to exhibit world wide in Master watercolour exhibitions. 
David Poxon is also a popular and trusted Judge for International Art Competitons. He is also the organiser of the very prestigious International Watercolour Masters Exhibitions. He is the author of 2 best selling drawing books, and his latest book is a 200 page watercolour book, Watercolour Heart & Soul which features over 100 of his award winning paintings. The book is available via Amazon or good book stores, or order signed copies on line direct from David at his web DavidPoxon.co.uk 
David was born in the Industrial heartland of the UK, but now makes his home in the rural countryside of Shropshire England.

teacher.aboutMe:
Ciao! Mi chiamo Sonia Padovanello e sono un' artigiana. 
Dalla mia passione per il mondo della carta è nata la mia attività Carta Muriel, oggi nella mia casa-bottega in provincia di Verona mi occupo della produzione di carta fatta a mano, principalmente per il mondo dei matrimoni.
La sostenibilità gioca un ruolo importante nel mio lavoro, così come nella vita. Ogni foglio di carta artigianale nasce da scarti, il prodotto che ne risulta è una carta fatta a mano riciclata, che rispetta l'ambiente. I progetti che realizzo sono un mix di creatività, minimalismo e amore per la natura, ogni nuova produzione è diversa e su misura!
Mi occupo personalmente di grafica, produzione della carta e stampa. Di recente è arrivata in laboratorio una pedalina per la stampa tipografica che mi permetterà di applicare alla carta artigianale un metodo di stampa del tutto artigianale, il letterpress!

Mi piace moltissimo viaggiare, proprio viaggiando ho scoperto il mondo della carta e me ne sono appassionata! 
Da un po' di anni ho scoperto la bellezza del viaggio a piedi e così ogni anno mi prendo un po' di tempo per scoprire l'Italia a piedi, con zaino in spalla. Amo la musica da sempre ed ogni momento della mia vita ha la sua colonna sonora, mi piace cantare, suonare la chitarra o l'ukulele. Amo il cibo, la natura, la vita semplice, fatta di piccole cose. Da quando vivo in Lessinia sto cercando di coltivare il mio piccolo orto di piante officinali, alcune di queste possono essere utilizzare per arricchire la carta con petali colorati!

teacher.aboutMe:
Juan Camilo Mazutier, professionally known as Mazvtier, is a blackwork tattoo artist and illustrator based in Espoo, Finland, near Helsinki. He works independently from Noctum Tattoo Studio, creating original tattoos that combine fine lines, dotwork, rich textures, and bold areas of black.

His work draws inspiration from mythology, dark fantasy, nature, and the relationship between illustration and the human body. Each piece is developed collaboratively with the client and adapted to complement their anatomy, allowing the composition to retain its movement, contrast, and readability over time.

Throughout his career, Mazvtier has worked internationally across Europe and the Americas, developing a distinctive visual language recognizable for its atmosphere, intricate detail, and emotional character. Alongside tattooing, he is passionate about illustration and education, sharing the creative and technical processes behind designing expressive blackwork tattoos.

Mazvtier currently welcomes local and international clients at Noctum Tattoo Studio in Espoo.

Instagram: @mazvtier

teacher.aboutMe:
Hola, me llamo Luis Cárdenas soy diseñador de formación y ceramista de profesión, soy cofundador de un taller cerámico llamado popdots, de una editorial llamada MERMA, soy fanático de la colaboración, la experimentación, la lectura, el jazz y la Nutella. 

Conforme más pasa el tiempo, más me doy cuenta que él hacer me hace pensar, y que la mayoría de mis ideas vienen desde la observación de el material como origen de mi quehacer.

La cerámica es un material que desde la primera vez que lo observe en un taller artesanal me cobro sentido, su cadencia, sus características, sus capacidades y mas aun sus posibilidades; por que mientras mas conocía procesos de artesanos y ceramistas diferentes, notaba una forma básica coherente para trabajar y una o dos cosas diferentes, pero siempre, siempre, siempre las recetas, formulas o procesos no eran cerrados, ni en esencia completos así que en el estudio comenzamos a trabajar en agregar agentes a las formulas para ver que podría salir y entonces fue cuando la investigación y la exploración formo parte fundamental de mi proceso de trabajo. 

Te quiero contar un poco del estudio, en el 2012 junto con mi socia Melissa Aldrete abrimos  p o p d o t s  un espacio con la finalidad única de expresar la memorabilidad de materiales típicos en un contexto contemporáneo, lo que buscamos en el estudio es fortalecer el proceso y el concepto, para así provocar el desarrollo de series únicas e infinitas que incrementan la maestría y entendimiento del material cerámico, manteniendo la experimentación y la continua búsqueda del dialogo entre el material, el ser  y su entorno.

Me llamo Helena Palau y soy una fotógrafa y videógrafa afincada en Barcelona. teacher.aboutMe:
Mi chiamo Clara sono una artigiana e designer, mi occupo di intrecci nel ambito dell' arredamento, in particolar modo di sedute intrecciate esclusivamente a mano e direttamente sulle strutture.
Mi definisco come INTRECCIATRICE, ho una formazione umanistica ed ho imparato questo mestiere da autodidatta, infatti il mio percorso è stato tutt'altro che lineare. Sono una persona  impulsiva e il mio istinto mi ha portato a cercare un mestiere che mi permettesse di sfogare la mia manualità e creatività. Dopo anni passati in cucina nel ristorante di famiglia ho scoperto la passione per il mondo della tessitura e dell'intreccio  e subito mi sono sentita nel mio ambiente naturale ed ho capito  il mio talento. Così nasce NODO2014, potrei definirlo come un brand, in realtà è qualcosa di più personale. NODO  sono io, è un percorso che evolve insieme a me, è un contenitore di colori, forme, trame e materiali che danno vita a prodotti artigianali creati con passione. Amo moltissimo creare e costruire  con le mani, non c’è nulla che mi dia più soddisfazione  dell’ immaginare  un oggetto e riuscire a dargli vita mettendo insieme  ingegno,  creatività e manualità. Amo l’attesa e il tempo che passa tra l’idea e il risultato finale, il tempo che rallenta  mentre sto intrecciando, il movimento ripetitivo motivato, passaggio dopo passaggio, dal desiderio di vedere il risultato finale. NODO2014 ha l'obiettivo di creare  oggetti con un'estetica personale e unica, la mia, espressa nella totale libertà, e quella del cliente personalizzando i lavori secondo le richieste.
Ho fatto la scelta di non seguire grosse produzioni e di creare artigianalmente i miei prodotti in tutte le loro fasi (anche le strutture delle mie collezioni vengono prodotti da artigiani che si trovano vicino a me) questo perché voglio valorizzare l’umanità del mio mestiere, infatti creo pezzi unici o piccole produzioni in serie.
Penso sia fondamentale consumare meno e meglio  e voglio che i miei prodotti rispecchino quest’ idea.
Recupero strutture già esistenti dandogli una nuova vita o creo prodotti nuovi che garantiscano una lunga durata e la possibilità di essere riparati e modificati nel tempo. Scelgo di utilizzare sia materiali naturali che sintetici a seconda dell' utilizzo che avrà il prodotto finale, infatti uso spesso filati a base di  plastica (riciclabile o riciclata) perché penso che la plastica sia un materiale molto utile se utilizzato in maniera intelligente, cioè per prodotti che debbano durare nel tempo e che non si usurino rapidamente. Il mio progetto è fondato sulla valorizzazione della tradizione artigiana e sul recupero delle tecniche antiche di impagliatura e tessitura per dare forma a innumerevoli pattern e suggestivi contrasti materici, scelte dei materiali e gli accostamenti cromatici rappresentano la connessione tra passato e futuro.
Ho scelto di vivere di questa professione perché è un mestiere che mi viene estremamente spontaneo e naturale, mi da soddisfazione e mi stimola moltissimo, ogni giorno mi sveglio con la voglia di andare nel mio laboratorio e creare. Non è un percorso semplice  ma ne vale sempre la pena , ogni singolo giorno . NODO2014 non è un progetto definito e statico ma appunto è in divenire e si modifica in base alle mie scelte e volontà , cambia e cresce con me così come le mie creazioni .

Soy fotógrafa y directora de arte. Trabajo en diferentes proyectos con especial interés en bodegones y moda. Soy también activista por el clima y feminista, actualmente enfocando mi trabajo en proyectos conscientes, seleccionando clientes con una producción ética y un interés especial en mostrar el cuerpo de la mujer de una manera real. 

En el pasado he trabajado con grandes marcas como Huawei, Uniqlo, Hoteles Hilton, LATAM Airlines, Smoking, Atlantic Airways y más. Hoy me encuentro colaborando con marcas emergentes de producción ética, vegana y local como Lamixtura, Baula, NocNoc, La Besnéta, Itaca, Mommus, Innia Beauty, entre otras.
He publicado editoriales en magazines como Contributor, Flanelle y Lula Japan.
Soy cofundadora de Pulpa, un foto club que gestiona encuentros con fotógrafas de distintas áreas proponiendo talleres, visionados y exposiciones.
También soy parte de una dupla creativa que explora el diseño con formas y objetos de producción ética y local en Baba Studio.

Me dediqué a la música toda mi vida, y en una época de mucho estudio e intensidad, comencé a  necesitar un espacio donde poder crear libremente sin tantas reglas. Aprendí a disparar en analógico y comencé a jugar con la foto. Al poco tiempo este nuevo campo laboral sucedió muy naturalmente. Trabajo únicamente de la fotografía desde que dejé Argentina para vivir en Europa hace ya unos 4 años.

Amo ser fotógrafa para crear universos e imaginar historias. 
La naturaleza siempre me inspira mucho; lo vivo es un elemento que está presente en casi todas mis fotos. Siento que de alguna manera tiene que necesariamente ser parte para dar sensibilidad a una obra. Somos uno con la naturaleza y me parece muy importante recordarlo siempre para ser más conscientes respecto a la manera en la que elegimos habitar el mundo.

teacher.aboutMe:
Born in Torquay, England 1952, Richard’s art began with drawing. His love of the countryside and the sea drew him to sketch and paint nature in and around his close environment.
Since those early days, his paintings have been exhibited in England, Europe and America and China.
Richard is principally self-taught apart from his schooling and a spell at Art college but his early fascination with drawing would prove essential to his later work.
 He has won two awards at the Royal Institute (for painters in watercolour) at the Mall Galleries in London - 2016/17 and his book - Down an English lane - was published in 2016.
The artist’s work depicts the moods and flavours of the countryside - ‘I like to paint the soul of the scene I’m working on, depicting the essence of that which is before me’.
The artist’s primary influences were the French Impressionists and the English watercolour masters; William Turner, John Cotman, William Russel-Flint. And later, the American exponents; Andrew Wyeth, Philip Jameson and Winslow Homer to name a few.

teacher.aboutMe:
Soy Claudio Cuevas, Soy Periodista profesional, 100% dedicado a digital. Vivo en Chile.

Me formé como periodista en la Universidad de Chile, donde comencé mi práctica profesional en tercer año, en el incipiente sitio web de la Radio Cooperativa, la radio informativa más importante del país. En esa época casi “no existía” lo digital, en el lejano 2003. De hecho, uno de los periodistas que trabajaba en el área estaba “castigado” ahí, por un error que había cometido al aire. Las publicaciones eran solo texto, apenas alguna foto y audio. Ni pensar en multimedia. 

Me di cuenta que esto era lo mío cuando surgió el desafío de las redes sociales, Twitter primero y Facebook después, como medios para comunicarse con la audiencia, derivar tráfico al sitio y darle algún sentido a este nuevo elemento que había entrado en la fórmula: la creación de contenido por parte de la audiencia. 

Tuve la suerte de entender que las reglas del comportamiento humano que siempre me habían apasionado también se aplicaban acá. Los efectos de imitación, la búsqueda de sentido de pertenencia, la necesidad de formar parte y de no perderse de nada funcionaban cuando las buscaba. Y entender las plataformas con sus propios objetivos y no como un todo (error común aún hoy en día) me dio un factor diferenciador de mi trabajo. 

Todo me ayudó a avanzar de ser practicante a editor general en Cooperativa, hasta que acepté el desafío de trabajar para una empresa. Si bien no fue lo desafiante que esperaba, fue el paso necesario para darme cuenta que el sentido de urgencia de los medios me apasionaba, pero esta vez buscaría algo que explotara más mi lado creativo. Fue así como llegué a Mega, primero al departamento de Marketing para comenzar a implementar estrategias digitales y luego a la Gerencia Digital. En Marketing pude crear campañas pensadas 100% para las plataformas digitales, en que las necesidades de nuestra marca y las tendencias en contenido nos permitieron desarrollar contenidos innovadores y exitosos como La cita de los sres Papis, Draw my Life de Tranquilo Papá o el juego Memorice de Ambar.

Esos proyectos me sirvieron para llamar la atención de universidades y del entonces nuevo departamento de negocios digitales del canal, donde pudimos meternos a fondo con los contenidos desarrollando exitosos crossovers de nuestras producciones dramáticas más exitosas, como Verdades Ocultas y Juegos de Poder en “Jurgos Ocultos” o “El cuento de Lorenzo”.

En “pandemia” respondimos junto al equipo a las necesidades de la gente con espacios para resolver de forma didáctica y experta las búsquedas más importantes en Google con 5 Tips, desde cómo hacer pan hasta cómo entretener a los niños durante el largo encierro.

También abrimos nuestras redes a los emprendedores, para apoyar a las microempresas que proliferaron en medio de la crisis desatada a partir del covid-19, con Emprendedores Mega.

En el desarrollo de estos proyectos lo más importante que aprendí fue a distinguir una metodología que permita llegar a un producto digital con un objetivo claro. Me encontré muchas veces con solicitudes que apuntaban más a un formato, a un resultado, que a un proceso. Y fue sólo cuando le logré dar forma a ese proceso, darle sentido, es cuando alcancé proyectos sólidos que dejan satisfechos a clientes, jefaturas y a mi mismo y me equipo. 

Clave en ordenar las ideas fue el desarrollo del curso que hago en el Diplomado de Periodismo Digital de la Universidad Católica, que ya va por su cuarta versión, con cada vez más interesados en participar. Además, me dio herramientas académicas que me permiten transmitir de mejor manera esta “navegación” del cambiante mundo digital. 

Compartir lo que he aprendido es algo que me apasiona.

teacher.aboutMe:
ENG - Hello, my name is Jelena and I am the founder of ricamoaltamoda.it. My passion for embroidery took off thanks to excellent training at the Lesage school in Paris, part of the Chanel world, and then at Hand and Lock in London, renowned for their work with the Queen's army and the royal family. My dedication was recognized in 2018 with an award in a Swarovski contest, which led me to discover the exclusive Swarovski archives in Austria.

In addition to being an enthusiastic embroiderer and teacher, I also collaborate with high fashion ateliers for the design and prototyping of embroideries for prêt-à-porter and haute couture collections. This experience has allowed me to deeply understand the needs and trends of the fashion industry, integrating the art of embroidery with modern design aesthetics.

My passion for embroidery was also inspired by my love for opera music. While attending the opera singing school, the embroidered theatrical costumes fascinated me, showing how embroidery could emphasize the characters and transformations of the characters on stage. The need to create unique jewelry for my concert dresses, on a limited budget, led me to learn how to embroider on my own.

In 2018, I founded my high fashion embroidery school, offering both online and in-person courses, with the goal of preserving and passing on the manual embroidery techniques. My courses are designed for anyone fascinated by the world of embroidery and wanting to learn to create masterpieces for both fashion and their personal pleasure. With my experience and guidance, I invite you to embark on a creative journey into the world of embroidery.

Come and discover the art and magic of embroidery with me!

ITA - Ciao, mi chiamo Jelena e sono la fondatrice di ricamoaltamoda.it. La mia passione per il ricamo ha preso il volo grazie a una formazione eccellente presso la scuola Lesage a Parigi, parte del mondo Chanel, e poi presso Hand and Lock a Londra, rinomati per il loro lavoro con l'esercito della regina e la famiglia reale. La mia dedizione è stata riconosciuta nel 2018 con un premio in un concorso Swarovski, che mi ha portato a scoprire gli esclusivi archivi Swarovski in Austria.

Oltre a essere un'appassionata ricamatrice e insegnante, collaboro anche con atelier di alta moda per la progettazione e la prototipazione di ricami per le collezioni prêt-à-porter e haute couture. Questa esperienza mi ha permesso di comprendere a fondo le esigenze e le tendenze dell'industria della moda, integrando l'arte del ricamo con la moderna estetica del design.

La mia passione per il ricamo è stata ispirata anche dalla mia amore per la musica lirica. Mentre frequentavo la scuola di canto lirico, i costumi teatrali ricamati mi hanno affascinato, mostrando come il ricamo potesse enfatizzare i caratteri e le trasformazioni dei personaggi sul palco. La necessità di creare gioielli unici per i miei abiti da concerto, con un budget limitato, mi ha portato a imparare a ricamare da sola.

Nel 2018, ho fondato la mia scuola di ricamo di alta moda, offrendo corsi sia online che in presenza, con l'obiettivo di preservare e tramandare le tecniche manuali di ricamo. I miei corsi sono progettati per chiunque sia affascinato dal mondo del ricamo e voglia imparare a creare capolavori sia per la moda che per il proprio piacere personale. Con la mia esperienza e guida, ti invito a intraprendere un viaggio creativo nel mondo del ricamo.

Vieni a scoprire l'arte e la magia del ricamo con me!

teacher.aboutMe:
Marta Cortese vive e lavora a Torino, in Italia; è nata e cresciuta ad Asti, tra le colline del Monferrato.

Architetto per formazione, ha scelto di non praticare la professione, ma di seguire la sua attitudine verso un mestiere creativo, in cui potersi esprimere più liberamente: ha iniziato quindi ad esplorare il mondo della comunicazione visiva, ha scoperto così la tipografia, la calligrafia, l’illustrazione e ha capito qual era il modo migliore per esprimere e unire la grande immaginazione creativa e l’innata consapevolezza estetica.

Dal 2015 si occupa in modo professionale di textile design, nel 2017 ha co-fondato lo studio nerodiseppia, attualmente non più attivo; nel 2020 ha scelto di proseguire in autonomia la sua attività di designer, firmando con il suo nome i disegni che realizza e seguendo più da vicino i propri clienti, con servizi studiati ad hoc.

In parallelo alla sua attività lavorativa, Marta ama dedicarsi alla calligrafia sperimentale, una variante che si avvicina al puro segno, fino all’astrazione completa della lettera; elabora ulteriormente le sue tavole calligrafiche, attraverso pieghe, tagli e rilegatura, e le trasforma in libri-scultura che si possono aprire e scoprire in tanti modi diversi, lasciandosi trasportare dal flusso creativo.

Questa pratica le permette di sperimentare con una tecnica manuale in grado di donarle una grande spinta creativa, che poi trasferisce anche nel suo lavoro quotidiano.

A Marta piace: viaggiare con lo zaino; fare lunghe passeggiate con il suo cane Corinna; passare le serate in compagnia di amici e di una buona bottiglia di vino rosso; visitare mostre d’arte; andare al cinema; lavorare la ceramica al tornio; fare binge-watching; mangiare grandi quantità di pasta; ascoltare musica elettronica, ma anche i cantautori italiani che mi ricordano i miei genitori (come Dalla e De Andrè); il trekking in montagna; parlare, le piace moltissimo parlare.

A Marta non piace: fare sport; avere gli amici lontani; dormire in hotel; guardare film fantasy; il cibo troppo speziato; la spiaggia con il lettino – è una vera punizione; il finocchio bollito; le scarpe bagnate; la pioggia; il freddo; gli occhiali appannati; lottare con la tecnologia; le battute pesanti; i collant; i menu impaginati male; guardare le foto sullo schermo della tv; le persone che parlano senza lasciarti mai intervenire.

teacher.aboutMe:
Elisa Seitzinger vive a Torino, dove lavora come illustratrice e artista visiva.
Ha studiato disegno e storia dell’arte a Firenze, Atlanta, Nizza e Londra.
Dal 2015 al 2020 è stata docente di morfologia e dinamica della forma e iconografia all’Istituto Europeo di Design di Torino.

Il suo percorso, ispirato ai codici stilistici dell’arte classica, dell’arte medievale sacra e cortese, della pittura primitiva, delle icone russe e dei mosaici bizantini, parte sempre dal disegno manuale a china, inseguendo una bidimensionalità e una staticità dalla forte carica simbolica. 

Doppia medaglia d’oro 2021 (categoria illustrazione didattica e scientifica e illustrazione per design e pubblicità) e medaglia di bronzo 2020 e 2021 (illustrazione di magazine) di Autori d’Immagini, Vincitrice del Premio Illustri
2018 - categoria Design e selezionata all’omonimo Festival nel 2019, tra i dieci illustratori più influenti d’Italia, selezionata alla mostra annuale della Society of Illustrators 2021 all’Illustration Museum di New York, shortlisted per i World Illustration Awards 2021 e 2022.

Ha esposto in numerose mostre collettive e personali in Italia, Francia, Regno Unito, Stati Uniti e Romania.  Tra cui:  al Museo delle Arti Applicate Oggi di Torino, alla galleria Le Dictateur all’interno di Futurdome a Milano, al MUSES di Savigliano, alla Biblioteca Oriani di Ravenna, all’Auditorium Parco della Musica e alla Farnesina a Roma, allo Studio 59 a Londra, alla Galleria NOI a Parigi ed è stata invitata come ospite a numerosi festival culturali e di arti visive, tra cui Italianism, Graphic Days, Inchiostro Festival, Pawchewgo, La Città dei Lettori, La Grande Invasione e Archivissima. In corso la sua prima mostra retrospettiva Seitzinger Alchemica al Forte Malatesta di Ascoli Piceno.

Ha lavorato e lavora per La Repubblica, L’Espresso, Il Sole 24ore, Corriere della Sera, Rolling Stone, RAI, BBC, National Geographic, Warner Music Group, Adobe, Spotify, Apple Music, Alipay, Taschen, Einaudi, Mondadori, Fandango, Feltrinelli, Salone Internazionale del Libro, Sabat Magazine, Favini, Barilla, Vantguard, Bulgari, Ginori 1735, Etro, L’Opificio, Kristina Ti.

teacher.aboutMe:
Hey, there! 

My name is Denisse Myrick and I'm an Arizona-based Fashion and Portrait photographer. I've been a photographer for a little over 13 years now. Most of my career has been focused on Street Style, which I love, but I have also had the chance to dive into portraiture, fine arts, weddings, and editorial fashion. 

I was lucky enough to launch my career in one of the most inspirational cities for fashion and style, New York City. There explored the streets of SoHo, Nolita, and Brooklyn, just to name a few, where you'll find some of the most interesting and inspiring outfits. I really got into Street Style when I started working with Fashion Bloggers. Through these projects, I was able to build a direct relationship with the brands we were shooting for which has opened up many doors for me. Because of how popular style blogging has become, my work has also been featured in many publications. Some of them are LATINA Magazine, InStyle, People Style, Elle, and Essence. I've also done red carpet which is one of the highlights of my career. 

I'm partially self-taught. I say partially because there are a few people who at the beginning of my career, were kind enough to let me shadow them, practice, and ask a plethora of questions. That experience along with the experiences I have had in the last 13 years has really catapulted me to where I am today. All of this experience also landed me the 2019 Hispanicize Award for "Best Photography Content Creator." Something I felt very honored to receive. 

Presently, I live with my family in Phoenix, Arizona. Being on the West Coast has allowed me more opportunities in Los Angeles where I often travel, and for recurring or new work back East, I travel as well. The last two years have allowed me to pivot to teaching. So I have been offering virtual mentorships, and that has been so fun. So much so that I'm really excited to bring this global mentorship if you will, to this platform. 

It isn't lost on me how valuable your time is. And so I really appreciate you taking the time to learn from me. I hope that you are able to confidently slay all of your Street Style projects, and I hope that you're able to apply what you've learned here to all of your favorite styles of photography. 

Thanks for giving me a shot!

teacher.aboutMe:
Sou Maria Gabriela Andrade, sou do Rio de janeiro, Brasil. Sou designer de moda por formação e nos últimos quatro anos tenho trabalhado com design de estampas, ilustração e venho me descobrindo também como artista visual.
Me formei no SENAI|CETIQT, no Rio de Janeiro e passei por instituições como a Central Saint Martins, na Inglaterra e a Porto illustration school, em Portugal.
Me iniciei no mundo da moda como estilista de calçados e acessórios, trabalhei nessa área durante 6 anos.
A partir de 2018 passei a trabalhar exclusivamente como designer de estampas, ilustradora e artista visual. Estive na marca carioca Farm por quase 4 anos, onde participei de projetos importantes como as parcerias com a Levi's e o Matte Leão. Em 2021 lancei uma coleção autoral de papelaria com a Cícero e no mesmo ano, ilustrei a nova linha mundial dos sabonetes Lux, que trazem essências de elementos brasileiros. Em meu trabalho autoral gosto de explorar a natureza, o tropical e a cultura brasileira. Trazer muita cor, contraste, textura e formas orgânicas. Tenho paixão por  explorar diferentes materiais como aquarela, guache, pastel, lápis de cor e tinta acrílica. O diálogo entre o universo da cultura brasileira e o universo tropical é algo que me encanta e movimenta.

Julio de Paiva é artesão e artista têxtil, e encontrou na materialidade dos fios, e no trabalho feito à mão, o meio para contar suas histórias e refletir sobre a própria trama da vida. Arquiteto, urbanista e também paisagista, Julio transporta as geometrias, cores e percepções da sua área de formação para dentro de suas criações artísticas.

Algumas de suas obras já foram expostas em galerias em São Paulo, Bruxelas, Cascais, Roma, Veneza e Vaduz, e muitas outras habitam, hoje, lares em várias partes do mundo.

Nascido no Nordeste, apaixonado pela cultura brasileira e aficionado pela América Latina, Julio busca constantemente reunir traços de suas raízes a todas essas referências, para criar peças únicas que celebrem essas culturas tão ricas e vibrantes.

teacher.aboutMe:
Evan Lorenzen (Art and Such Evan) is a multi-disciplinary artist that resides in Denver, Colorado. He currently spends most of his time working on miniature illustrations, woodworking, and animation. To test his natural limits, Evan does not use any magnifying instruments during the miniature drawing process.  Additionally, Evan considers it very awkward and unsettling to write biographies in the third person as he found out in the construction of this traditionally-styled artist’s bio. 

Focusing on the relationships between painting and animation, he graduated in 2013 from Marlboro College with a Bachelor of the Arts. Evan worked as a designer at a screen printing shop in Denver before becoming a full-time artist and tattooer.  He started exploring the realm of micro, handmade books, which led to his current interest in miniature illustrations- most of which are around 1 inch tall. Primarily working in pen and ink as well as watercolor, Evan currently finds himself influenced by mythology, medieval woodblock prints, cartoons, and the natural world.

teacher.aboutMe:
Soy Angela Garcia, fotógrafa colombiana, radicada en Israel. Tengo alrededor de 10 años de experiencia trabajando en la industria de la moda, donde también desempeñé cargos de estilismo, dirección de arte y modelaje, especializándome finalmente en la fotografía de moda. 

He trabajado con grandes clientes como RayBan y Shein, y muchos mas diseñadores de moda.

Mi trabajo se caracteriza por el uso de luz natural en todas sus condiciones, uso de colores para crear sensaciones, y uso del estilismo, arte y direccion de modelo para crear una narrativa
 
Desde pequeña supe que mi vida y mi enfoque giraría en torno al arte.  Por influencia familiar la música siempre fue parte de mi dia a dia junto con la Pintura y  el diseño, pero mi vínculo con la fotografía comenzó cuando veía fotografías antiguas con mi abuela y me asombraba la manera en la que se podían conservar esos instantes por siempre, tiempo después me hice dueña y protectora de la cámara familiar, con la cual comencé a experimentar fotografiando en la calle, a mi familia y amigos. Después me interesé por el mundo de la moda y trabaje como modelo en algunas campañas de ropa, de ahi me intereso todo el trabajo del equipo detrás de esas producciones, y me dedique a realizar estilismo y dirección de arte para fotografía y videos musicales, comencé a aprender el uso de la cámara con amigos y colegas fotógrafos, tras un largo tiempo de ahorro compre mi primera cámara profesional. Después de meses de práctica descubrí que tomar fotos era mi pasión más grande y que a eso me dedicaría profesionalmente.

Mi formación académica se ha basado principalmente en el autoaprendizaje. A base de experimentación y práctica he ido construyendo mi conocimiento fotográfico lo cual me ha llevado a perfeccionar mi técnica, encontrando y desarrollando mi estilo propio.

Mi trabajo principal se basa en realizar campañas de moda para marcas, editoriales para revistas y para mi portafolio personal. De esta manera he logrado que mis fotografías fueran publicadas  internacionalmente en revistas como Vogue Italia, Lucy’s Magazine, Flanelle Magazine, Solstice Magazine, Sticks & Stones Agency, Dreamingless Magazine, Creators Magazine, entre otros. 
Tengo tambien un canal de YOUTUBE donde comparto detras de camara de mis photoshoots, consejos de edicion y temas relacionados al mundo de la moda.

Actualmente he llegado a un punto en mi carrera en el que quiero aportar y compartir mis conocimientos a otros fotógrafos y amantes de la fotografía, de una manera práctica y útil, y así fomentar el autodescubrimiento abriendo las puertas y un mundo lleno de posibilidades laborales y creativas.

Bianca Nazari sempre foi artista! Desenhando no papel ou contando histórias, sempre gostou de se expressar através da arte e da comunicação. Encontrou um caminho para trabalhar com isso como ilustradora, quando se mudou para São Paulo. Começou a criar conteúdo para as redes sociais e ali também publicava seus desenhos e contava histórias sobre seu cotidiano, na intenção de documentar, se divertir, e espalhar conhecimento sobre a área. Como ilustradora, trabalhou para os mercados de publicidade e editorial com empresas como Wacom, Itaú, Jovem Nerd e Faber-Castell.

Atualmente, do outro lado da mesa, cria conexões e direciona artistas trabalhando como Recrutadora de Artistas. Começou sua carreira de recrutadora na Wildlife Studios, empresa de games mobile brasileira, e hoje é Senior Recruiter na Envar Studio, um estúdio de Outsource da Suécia que provê serviços artísticos para grandes empresas de games como a Riot, Tencent, Blizzard e Netflix. Mas, mesmo como recrutadora em horário comercial, Bianca continua desenhando e criando conteúdo para as redes sociais nas horas vagas. Com sua experiência como ilustradora freelancer, lidando com clientes, divulgando conteúdo nas redes sociais e agora como recrutadora, espera ampliar as possibilidades de mercado e continuar impulsionando carreiras dos artistas mundialmente.

Fui seleccionado para aparecer en la sección Fresh de la Revista Communication Arts Magazine en el año 2002.
 
Mi obra ha sido incluida en galleries en New York, Madrid, Los Angeles, San Francisco, Mexico City, France, Berlin, y en museos como Museo Carrillo Gil, Museum of art Oceanside, Museum Contemporary Arts Ssan Diego, Museo de Arte Zapopan, Museum International Des Arts Modesties de Ssettee. There's something incredibly satisfying about using just your arms and hands as tools to create something completely unique, and I'm delighted to be able to share my love for this craft here!

teacher.aboutMe:
I'm a playwright, screenwriter, actor, and writing instructor. I lived in New York City for 13 years, where I earned my BFA in Theatre from New York University's Tisch School of the Arts and my MFA in Playwriting from Columbia University. I received a 2023 Creation Grant from the Vermont Arts Council / National Endowment for the Arts and I was the 2021 winner of the Kernodle New Play Award, the 2020 winner of the New Works Initiative at Good Luck Macbeth Theatre, and a 2019 winner of the Columbia @ Roundabout New Play Reading Series. 

My plays have been developed and presented in NYC, London, and across the U.S. with Roundabout Theatre Company, American Stage, Urban Stages, Williamstown Theatre Festival, Hartford Stage, Barter Theatre, and more. I was a finalist for Theatre503's International Playwriting Award, the Jewish Playwriting Contest, and the Austin Film Festival Pitch Competition. I've been a semifinalist for the Princess Grace Award (twice), the O'Neill National Playwrights Conference (three times), the Bay Area Playwrights Festival (three times), the Blue Ink Playwriting Award, the Ashland New Plays Festival, Berkeley Rep's Ground Floor, and more.

My TV pilot "Summerland" was a 2021 finalist for the Big Apple Film Festival and a 2021 semifinalist for the NYC International Screenplay Contest and Reno-Tahoe Screenplay Contest. I've learned a lot about the world of film and television from my work assisting TV writer James Manos (Dexter, The Sopranos) on several new projects in development for HBO Max, BMW, and more.

I've had so many great teachers in my writing career, and I love nothing more than being able to share what I've learned (and what I'm still learning!) with others. I've been a guest lecturer at the University of Vermont, University of Arkansas MFA Playwriting program, New York University, and Hunter College, and have taught stage & screenwriting workshops with The Writer's Rock, Tribeca Performing Arts Center, the Burlington Writers Workshop, and more. I also offer private coaching, dramaturgy, and script consultation for writers at all levels and at all stages of their projects.

I'm passionate about creating art with a purpose. My writing process is research-driven and collaborative, focusing on character-based explorations of socially relevant subjects in the form of comedy, drama, and many things in between. Through storytelling, we are practicing for the world: it's a safe space to express our feelings, to share our stories, and to engage with points of view that might be unfamiliar or even uncomfortable. I believe wholeheartedly in the power of storytelling to change our world, and I am passionate about sharing that potential with writers of all ages and experiences.

teacher.aboutMe:
Hi! I'm Ivo Müller, I’m an actor from Brazil, who has been working between São Paulo and California. 
I also work as a creative producer, writer, acting coach, and teacher. 
Theater gave me the fundamentals to teach this class. Besides having group theater training and performing works by Pirandello, Strindberg, J.P. Sartre, I was part of the ensemble of an award-wining version of “Twelve Angry Men” and we performed for huge audiences in sold-out sessions in Brazil and Portugal. Another important experience is my solo performance work about poet Rainer Maria Rilke, where I experience the fears and pleasures of being alone in front of a live audience. 
As a screen actor, I have about 40 credits including productions from Brazil, Argentina, Portugal, and the U.S. Some favorites include "Tabu", filmed in Africa and directed by Miguel Gomes (2 awards at the Berlin Film Festival, Best Ensemble CinEuphoria - 2012), short film: The Orphan" (Queer Palm in Cannes 2018), and recurring roles and co-stars on television shows from Sony, TV Globo,  HBO Latin America, History Channel, Universal Chanel, and MTV Brazil. 
Teaching is a reference I've had since childhood: my grandparents from both sides were teachers. My first job was as an English teacher and later, as my acting career took off, I started to teach actors and directors at film schools (Academia Internacional de Cinema and Inspiratorium Film School), in Brazil. In the US I worked as an assistant teacher for late actor/acting coach Clark Middleton (Twin Peaks, The Blacklist).  
Follow me on Instagram: @ivoomuller

teacher.aboutMe:
Hallöchen, ich bin Anne - die Gründerin und Inhaberin von von.anne, meinem kleinen Kindermode- und Stofflabel !

Aber von vorne:
Nach meinem Abitur und einem abgebrochenen Studium hat meine Oma mir das Nähen beigebracht. Zunächst diente es nur als Hobby und ich postet hin und wieder meine genähten Stücke auf Instagram. Dort stieg das Interesse schnell. Ich meldete mein Gewerbe an, es verkaufte sich immer mehr und so machte ich mich nach meiner Ausbildung zur Erzieherin 2020 Vollzeit selbstständig mit meinem Label.

Seit zwei Jahren stecke ich nun all meine Zeit und Energie in mein Label. Zuerst gab es nur genähte Kinderkleidung, irgendwann fing ich nebenbei noch an zu Illustrieren und ließ die Motive auf Stoff drucken. Mittlerweile verkaufe ich viele eigene Stoffe, launche monatlich neue Designs, das Kleidungssortiment ist deutlich gewachsen und es gibt sogar Papeterie mit meinen Illustrationen.
Vor allem kindliche Motive mit kleinen Details und lustigen Accessoires in Buntstift- und Aquarell-Optik zeichnen mich aus. Ich arbeite hauptsächlich mit Procreate und Photoshop und meine Ideen gehen mir fast nie aus !

- 


Hello, I'm Anne and I'm the founder and owner of von.anne, my small business for children's fashion and fabrics!

But let us start at the beginning:
After graduating from high school and dropping out of college, my grandmother taught me how to sew. At first it was just a hobby and I occasionally post my sewn pieces on Instagram, but the interest in my pieces grew quickly there. I registered my business, i sold more and more and in 2020 I started to do it as my full-time job. Next to that I made a degree as a early year teacher.

It's been two years now and I still put all of my heart into "von.anne". At first there were only selfsewn children's clothing, but at some point I started to illustrate and let the illustrations print on fabric. Now I sell a lot of my own fabrics, launch new designs every month, the clothing range has grown significantly and there is even stationery with my illustrations.
Illustrations for children with small details and funny accessories in a selfdrawn- and watercolor-look are typical for me. I mainly work with Procreate and Photoshop and I almost never run out of ideas!

teacher.aboutMe:
Eva-Lotta Lamm is a designer, author and visual thinker. After a 15-year-long career as a UX / digital product designer working in Paris and London for Google, Skype, and Yahoo!, she shifted her professional focus to her life-long passion of visual thinking.

She is now based in Berlin, running her own business designing (physical and digital) products that teach a global audience to use sketching as a tool for understanding, thinking and communicating more efficiently. Her mission is to empower people to make the complex problems they face in their work and daily life visual so they can ‘see’ them from a fresh perspective and solve them with more confidence, creativity and clarity.

Eva-Lotta is a sought after expert in her field. She is regularly speaking at international design conferences on the topics sketching, sketchnoting and visual thinking and has been teaching her craft both in-person and online for over a decade (evalotta.shop/courses). 

In her spare time, Eva-Lotta practices yoga and improvisation, loves travelling, languages and learning new things. These passions have inspired several of her books capturing her experiences in the form of rich visual notes (evalotta.shop/collections/books).

teacher.aboutMe:
I'm a professional artist and illustrator best known for my dream-like depictures of landscapes. I specialize in watercolor and pencil but I've done numerous workshops in other techniques as well. 

I can't even recall the days when I wasn't drawing or painting. My love for art dates back to my very early childhood. 

Since 2012 I am the owner of the Art School KRESKA in Poland, where I've been teaching watercolor and perspective drawing over the years up till now. It wasn't my first time teaching though - I've been an art instructor at an architectural drawing course in Warsaw since 2007.
The year 2020 and the global pandemic have forced me to start teaching online and by doing so I was able to reach a bigger audience and gain recognition around the world.
Through those many years of painting with watercolor, I've developed many experimental techniques that I haven't seen used by anyone else. I've also improved some of the commonly known techniques to best suit my needs as a landscape artist.

In my work, the most common motifs are trees and clouds, because I have a special love for them. I always look at nature and the light through the eyes of a child - absorbing and remembering small details and colors in great delight.

AWARDS
Top Rising Star Award in the International Watercolour Masters Competition 2022 (IWM2022)

Mientras estaba haciendo el doctorado en neurociencia, empecé un food blog con recetas vegetarianas sanas y sabrosas. Me pasaba mi tiempo libre inventado nuevas combinaciones de sabores y texturas y empecé el blog como un registro de estos inventos. 

Desde el primer momento di mucha importancia a la estética y compré mi primera cámara DSLR para que las imágenes fuera una invitación visual a probar mis recetas. 

Poco a poco el foco se fue desplazando de la creación de recetas a su captura con la cámara, empecé a leer, estudiar y experimentar todo lo que pude.

Dos niños y una tesis más tarde di el salto y me empecé a dedicar profesionalmente. Actualmente he sido nombrada una de las mejores fotógrafas gastronómicas del mundo y creo imágenes para revistas, packaging, restaurantes, libros de cocina y publicidad online e impresa.

Con mis fotos quiero comunicar mi amor y fascinación por el mundo de la cocina, contar las historias que se dan alrededor de ella y transmitir las sensaciones que me despierta.

teacher.aboutMe:
¡Hola! Mi nombre es Laura , y soy la persona que está detrás de Susimiu.
Mi historia con el ganchillo comenzó hace ya algunos años.
Durante toda mi vida mi casa ha estado llena de mantas hechas por mi abuela, de todas las formas, tamaños y colores. Siempre me han encantado, así que un día como otro cualquiera me propuse aprender a hacerlas yo misma( cosa que por aquel entonces me parecía imposible)
Así, poco a poco, con la ayuda de Google ,y haciendo y deshaciendo cientos de veces, fui aprendiendo todos los puntos y trucos. Fue todo un aprendizaje.
Pocos meses más tarde, ya tenía acabada mi primera manta, y yo, muy orgullosa de ella, quise compartirla en un blog con el resto del mundo, con todos los patrones necesarios para hacerla.
Y así, y de esta forma tan sencilla, fue como empecé en esta maravillosa aventura.
Podéis ver todos mis trabajos en mi web , Susimiu, diseñada y elaborada por mi misma; donde comencé enseñando recetas de dulces , para terminar especializándome en el gran mundo del ganchillo.
Espero que os guste lo que hago, pero sobre todo, que lo disfrutéis tanto como disfruto yo haciéndolo.
¡Gracias por estar aquí!

teacher.aboutMe:
Hola, soy Maru Godàs. 
Me dedico a ilustrar y a pintar en cuadernos. También hago libros y doy talleres. 

Me formé hace bastantes años en la escuela IDEP de diseño y en la Llotja de Barcelona.
Creo que en ese momento yo ya quería ser artista pero esa palabra me venía muy grande y preferí centrarme en el camino a medias entre lo funcional y lo artístico, me quedé con el diseño gráfico.
Casi todo el tiempo de mi vida profesional trabajé como free-lance en mi propio estudio, dando servicios de diseño y de ilustración para un montón de editoriales: RBA, Cruïlla, Planeta, Salvat... 
Desde lanzamientos de fascículos y gadgets para Barbie hasta maravillosas colecciones de National Geographic, creo que diseñé prácticamente de todo. Paralelamente, siempre tenía algun que otro proyecto de ilustración entre las manos, y seguía pintando cuando me quedaba algo de tiempo. Eran esas pasiones que una va dejando atrás mientras cumple los encargos de clientes importantes. 
 
Pero llegó un punto de inflexión que debo agradecer profundamente al colectivo de los Urban Sketchers. Me enganché a ellos como una nueva oportunidad para desempolvar esas pasiones: me empujaron a salir a la calle en busca de inspiración, y a llevar siempre un cuaderno encima. Aprendí nuevas formas de mirar y de dibujar e hice un montón de amigos.
Creo allí encontré mi voz, mis colores, mis cuadernos. 
Desde entonces me dedico solamente a eso, a ilustrar y a pintar.
Me apasionan todas las técnicas: desde la tinta china hasta el óleo, pasando por los acrílicos, el gouache, la acuarela y los lápices de colores. Me encanta jugar con ellas, explorar nuevos lenguajes y compartir lo que descubro con mis alumnos. 
Suelo salir a pintar al aire libre, pero también me encierro en mi estudio durante largas horas. 
Trabajo en cuadernos que elaboro yo misma y que me acompañan en mis viajes, aunque también los uso para desarrollar procesos orientados a proyectos concretos. 
Trabajar en cuaderno es trabajar en tu propio libro de artista.

teacher.aboutMe:
Arturo Tedeschi is an Italian architect and computational designer internationally renowned for his sculptural and visionary approach combined with research on advanced design methods, materials and fabrication technologies. His use of digital technologies blurs the line between disciplines and emphasizes the semantic and emotional values of objects which engage all the senses. Qualities such as functionality, sustainability and innovation are always complemented by a vision where forms are capable of triggering an emotional response and inspire the user. He collaborated with world-known brands and offices providing services related to algorithmic modeling, complex geometry, digital fabrication, virtual reality and data driven design. His personal work has been featured in international magazines such as Forbes, Wired, Dezeen, AD, Business Insider and exhibited worldwide. He is the author of the book AAD Algorithms-Aided Design unanimously considered the global reference on the subject and since 2011 he promoted and directed several events and workshops that trained a generation of students and professionals. In 2011 he started an intense teaching activity as the director and tutor of the AAD workshop series (2011-2019) in Rome and Milano. In 2011 and 2012 he co-directed the AA Rome Visiting School for the Architectural Association. He taught and was an invited speaker at Politecnico di Milano, IUAV (Venice), The University of Sydney, Parsons School of Design (New York), Dubai Institute of Design and Innovation, University of Edinburgh, Universidad Europea (Madrid), ControlMad (Madrid), ISCTE-IUL (Lisbon). 
In 2019 he was appointed Italian Ambassador for Design by Italian Ministry of Foreign Affairs. He lives and works in Milano.

teacher.aboutMe:
In my work, I use a sewing machine to create thread drawings and large scale installations. Using my sewing machine, I am able to create a range of designs- from objects in my home like backpacks and shoes to brightly coloured abstract patterns. I often sew into fabric that dissolves in water so  I can build up stitched lines on a temporary surface.  The crossing threads create strength so that when the fabric is dissolved, the thread drawing can hold together without a base. With only the thread remaining, these images appear as though they would be easily unraveled and seemingly on the verge of falling apart, despite the works raveled strength. I am interested in thread's assumed vulnerability,  its ability to unravel, and its strength when it is sewn together.
I show my work in galleries nationally and internationally with recent solo exhibitions in Ottawa (ON), Virginia Beach (VA) and Vancouver (BC) and has completed residencies at Harbourfront Centre’s Textile Studio in Toronto, and the Klondike Institute of Art and Culture in Dawson City, Yukon. I have received awards and scholarships from the Ontario Crafts Council, The Canada Council for the Arts, The Handweavers and Spinners Guild of America, The Young Masters Art Prize, The Ontario Society of Artists, The Surface Design Association and The Embroiderers Guild of America.

Hello! I’m Emily Hlaváč Green, a New Zealand-born photographer currently splitting my time between New York and Los Angeles. I specialize in creative lifestyle, portrait and narrative photography with a focus on shooting for clients who desire something with a narrative or emotive element. My work has taken me around the world and I have shot for the likes of The New York Times, Stella Artois, Equinox, Footlocker and Reebok.

Inspired by the magic of everyday life, my work explores the space between intimacy, nostalgia and imagination. I love to seek out creative ways to photograph people, drawing on environmental spaces and unique contexts and often shoot medium format film in addition to digital.
My past lives include teaching fashion photography workshops in China, environmental assignments in Peru, Mexico and Tonga, directing music videos and shooting cook books.

teacher.aboutMe:
Center for textile design, art and culture — based in Prato, Italy.
We operate both as a creative hub and as a design office/consultancy studio. Our 400-sqm headquarters are divided into an open laboratory for textile production, experimentation and research, a shared studio space/coworking and an exhibition area. 

Lottozero’s mission is to create a fertile environment for textile research and experimentation in design and art, and an international base for networking in the textile sector.

We encourage and support the development of emerging talents of textile art and design through international scouting and targeted residencies in our headquarters in Prato, one of the main textile districts of Europe. We bring talented, motivated, young European artists to Prato. We initiate an exchange between local textile production companies and creative from all over the world. Our space is open and accessible to everyone.

teacher.aboutMe:
Hi! Im a freelance illustrator based in the historic city of Cambridge, England. I was born to two very creative parents, my father a photographer from Colombia, and my English mother has always loved painting & making, So growing up i was always surrounded by art and encourage to create. 
My deep love for nature, organic shapes, pattern and punchy colour palettes seen throughout my work, largely comes from the love I have for my father land, Colombia. Travelling, books, growing plants, searching for exotic artifacts in antique shops are all things which also influence my life & work. 

In 2006 I studied illustration at the Cambridge school of Art, I then completed a Masters degree in children's book illustration in 2014, also at the Cambridge school of Art. The course helped me to gain confidence and hone my work and love of print making, pattern and colour. 
After graduating I was given a book publishing deal with Simon & Schuster in New York and since then i've illustrated over 10 picture books for children, written 3 picture books and designed and illustrated over 20 book covers, with publishers from all over the world.
In 2019 i was lucky enough to illustrate the new covers for Philip Pullman's 'His dark materials', which was a real dream come true. That same year I also won The American Society of illustrators gold medal for my wordless picture book 'The Balcony'.

When I'm not illustrating picture books I create screen prints, Riso prints and other illustrated goods, such as stationary and textiles and I sell them in my online shop and at illustration fairs around the U.K. I discovered my love for print making whilst at uni and have grand plans to one day have my very own screen printing studio where i can spend my days creating big, bright and botanically inspired work :)

teacher.aboutMe:
Living on the edge of the Peak District in the UK and surrounded by hills, woods and open moorland, Craww’s work reflects an ongoing fascination with the natural world, and the relationships we have with it.

His work creates narratives that are drawn from the beauty to be found in contradictions and ambiguity - life and death, beauty and decay, strength, fragility, the interplay between conflicting and complementing forces of nature and the constructs that mark our passing.

Each piece is an aspect of an unfolding story that writes itself as he works on it. As his muses pass through time and place they are accompanied in their journey by birds and animals. Often framed by classical and historical reference points and surrounded by flowing lines and natural forms, his work uncovers their ambiguous connections and hidden narratives, exploring how the passage of time shapes the relationship between ourselves and nature.

Exploring ideas in graphite and charcoal, discovery is a large part of his work. Ideas and themes developing over time, often as a “stream of consciousness” rather than clearly defined concepts and objectives. In working through his ideas he relies heavily on his sketchbook where sketches and scribbles take on a life of their own before finding life on the canvas.

teacher.aboutMe:
Je m’appelle Fiona, je suis designer végétal spécialisée en fleurs pressées. L'âme romantique et passionnée, sensible à l'esthétique vintage et amoureuse de la nature, j’ai créé l'atelier de création d'herbiers Chemin des Marettes en 2018. 

Chemin des Marettes c'est un univers joyeux et coloré qui rassemble autour de l’amour des fleurs. Je crée des collections d’herbiers autour de différentes thématiques symboliques comme par exemple, les déesses de la Grèce antique, les sentiments, la musique, les étoiles, le rêve.
Le langage des fleurs tient une place très importante dans mes créations et m'a inspiré à créer la collection d'affiches Botanica et un Floroscope d'astrologie de fleurs.
En déclinant mes créations sur des supports imprimés, j'ai la chance de collaborer avec des marques du secteur de la beauté, de la papeterie et du prêt-à-porter.

La transmission étant une des valeurs fondatrices de Chemin des Marettes, j'ai créé un livre qui partage mon savoir-faire et mon regard sur la nature et la nécessité de ralentir le rythme pour pouvoir l'apprécier.

teacher.aboutMe:
I am a New York-based graphic designer and visual artist who paints on everyday objects and found materials. Using the emptied-out tea bag as my canvas, I draw, paint, print, and collage moody, evocative, and sometimes whimsical art on used teabag paper. In addition to the used tea bags, I paint on eggshells, acorns, pistachio shells, mail envelopes, leaves, stones, wine corks and, yes, even paper. 

In 2016, I published my first coffee table book, 363 Days of Tea: A Visual Journal on Used Teabags (Mascot Books), followed by Reclaimed Canvas: Reimagining the Familiar (Mascot Books) in 2018. I want viewers to keep an open mind and think beyond the boundaries of what they may consider traditional art.

teacher.aboutMe:
Hello, Domestika!

I'm Jordan J. Lloyd, a British author, visual historian and the Creative Director of Unseen Histories, bringing the past to life for The Times, LIFE and Unsplash.

My career in the field of colorization and visual history has allowed me to work with some of the world's largest publishers, media brands, museums, record labels and newspapers; with front covers for National Geographic History, HISTORY, LIFE and People Magazine on some of the world's most iconic photographs from the death mask of Tutankhamun to the Eiffel Tower under construction. My work has also appeared in The Times, the BBC, The Guardian, The Daily Mail and many more. 

In 2020, I was honoured to work with Unsplash – the world's largest repository freely-usable images – and the US Library of Congress to colorize public domain photographs the Civil Rights movement featuring Martin Luther King Jr., Rosa Parks, Angela Davis and many key moments from the civil rights era. These high definition restored and (now) full colour photographs are now available for free, and have been viewed more than 60 million times with nearly a million downloads.

It is a privilege to work with Domestika to help creatives and students of history to engage with and unravel hidden stories from the past through the medium of photographic restoration and colorization.

---

¡Hola, Domestika!

Soy Jordan J. Lloyd, autor británico, historiador visual y director creativo de Unseen Histories, que da vida al pasado para The Times, LIFE y Unsplash.

Mi carrera en el campo de la coloración y la historia visual me ha permitido trabajar con algunas de las editoriales, marcas de medios, museos, sellos discográficos y periódicos más importantes del mundo; con portadas para National Geographic History, HISTORY, LIFE y People Magazine en algunas de las fotografías más icónicas del mundo, desde la máscara mortuoria de Tutankamón hasta la Torre Eiffel en construcción. Mi trabajo también ha aparecido en The Times, la BBC, The Guardian, The Daily Mail y muchos más. 

En 2020, tuve el honor de trabajar con Unsplash -el mayor repositorio de imágenes de libre uso del mundo- y la Biblioteca del Congreso de los Estados Unidos para colorear fotografías de dominio público del movimiento por los derechos civiles en las que aparecían Martin Luther King Jr, Rosa Parks, Angela Davis y muchos momentos clave de la época de los derechos civiles. Estas fotografías restauradas en alta definición y (ahora) a todo color ya están disponibles de forma gratuita, y han sido vistas más de 60 millones de veces con casi un millón de descargas.

Es un privilegio trabajar con Domestika para ayudar a creativos y estudiantes de historia a involucrarse y desentrañar historias ocultas del pasado a través del medio de la restauración fotográfica y la colorización.

Sou Ariádine, brasileira e artista visual independente, especializada em papercutting e técnicas em papel. Fui influenciada esteticamente por trabalhos manuais de família como tricot, crochet e rendas e em 2010, durante um período sabático de 2 anos na Índia, reconheci no fazer manual a prática de uma meditação ativa e venho me dedicando a ela desde então.
Meus trabalho dialoga com alto contraste, olhar negativo positivo e opostos. Tem como temática padronagens da natureza, ilusões de ótica e o universo feminino e psicanalítico. 
Além de obras autorais e encomendas para coleções privadas também trabalho com ilustrações e adereços cenográficos. Já fiz trabalhos para clientes como Editora Abril, Editora Elefante, Disney Channel, GNT, Coca- Cola,  Bombay Sapphire e Cachaça 51.
Compartilhar a técnica e o fazer terapêutico que ela traz sempre foi uma das minhas maiores motivações, isso se solidificou nas aulas que dou desde 2016. É um prazer poder compartilhar e absorver desse exercício com o maior número de pessoas possível!
